tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag gi zin bris bstan pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi satwa bh+yo na mo na maḥ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir nges don bstan pa'i bdag /'gran med dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'jig rten mgon po'i rnam 'phrul jo nang pa/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kun bdag po ma lus 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gsang gsum zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i dngos/ /skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i rje/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir bshad par bya ba la bzhi ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las su sgrub pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs su bstan pa dang*/ de gdul bya mchog dman gyi dbang gis theg pa tha dad du 'gyur tshul dang*/ de las skabs su babs pa'i don bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis rgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung*/ /zhes spyod 'jug las gsungs pa ltar/ grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur ba'i sems can rnams chos dge ba la 'jug pa thams cad dang*/ chos 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa rnams kyis dka' thub dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa dge ba'i chos la 'jug pa gang yod pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang la gang 'dul gyi thugs rje'i 'jug pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / ༈ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa rnams la/ thar pa bsgrub pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos kho na blang bar bya ba yin la/ de yang phyogs zhen tsam ni ma yin te/ phyi nang gi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la brtag pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na sdig pa mtha' dag spangs pa dang*/ dge ba mtha' dag gis legs par brgyan pas/

ngan song gi sgo khegs shing*/ mtho ris kyi go 'phang bde blag tu sgrub pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab la sogs pa'i sgos thar pa bsgrub pa dang*/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la sogs pa'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i lam ston pa dang*/ gzhung lugs gzhan de dag las ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston pa lta ci zhig smos/ dkar nag rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor la brten nas/ mtho ris sgrub pa'i lam ston pa tsam yang shin tu dkon pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du yang*/ bdag ni sangs rgyas phyogs mi 'dzin/ /ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang*/ /gang zhig rig par ldan pa'i tshig /de nyid 'ba' zhig kho bos len/ /zhes slob dpon bde byed bdag pos lha las phul byung gi bstod par bshad pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa ni/ de skad du yang*/ gtam bya rin chen phreng ba las/ brda' sprod pa dag ji lta bur/ /yi ge'i phyi ma glog 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /ji tsam bzod pa'i chos bstan to/ kha cig la ni sdig pa las/ /rnam par bzlog phyir chos bstan to/ kha cig bsod nams bsgrub bya'i phyir/ kha cig la ni gnyis brten pa/ kha cig la ni gnyis mi brten// zab mo 'khu 'khrig can 'jig pa/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ re zhig byang chub sgrub pa'i skal ba med pa rnams la/ las 'bras kyi blang dor tsam bstan nas mtho ris la 'jog pa dang*/ thar pa tsam sgrub pa'i skal ba yod kyang blo chung rnams la theg dman gyi sde snod bstan nas/ nyan rang gi sa la 'god pa dang*/ blo gros chen po rnams la theg pa chen po bstan cing*/ de la yang gdul bya gtso bo dang phal pa'i dbye bas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nges don ston pa'i mdo so sor gsungs pa dang*/ blo gros ches che ba dbang po rnon po rab kyi phul du gyur pa rnams la sngags kyi theg pa bstan te/

de la rgyud sde bzhir yod pa/ de dag kyang so so'i mos pa'i dbang gis yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog/ rnal 'byor bla med de lhag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bzhi pa la/ theg pa mchog dman gyi lam gyi khyad par dang*/ theg mchog gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rnam bzhag dang*/ de las mthar thug gi 'bras bu ji ltar 'grub tshul te gsum las/ dang po la theg dman gyi lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag dang*/ de dag las gsang sngags khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ /dang po ni/ bsam pa khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal thams cad las dang nyon mongs pa las byung bar shes nas/ de las thar 'dod kyi sems bden zhen dang bcas pas/ lam gyi 'jug sgo thun mong gi skyabs 'gro dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa la brten nas lta ba gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ spyod pa gzhan gnod gzhi bcas las bzlog pa dang*/ sgom pa zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa las grol ba'i phung po lhag med kyi myang 'das sgrub par byed do/ /de yang nyan thos rnams la ni yon tan gyi khyad par mang po thob pa dang*/ sems can gyi don ci rigs par spyod pa yod mod kyi/ /'on kyang nyan thos dgra bcom pa la yon tan gyi khyad par de dag nges pa dgos pa ni ma yin te/ shes rab rkyang grol gyi dgra bcom pa la/ mngon shes lnga la sogs pa med pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig lung gi chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam las mi mkhyen pa yang yod par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ / nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis car yang*/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa sa bon dang bcas pa spangs pa ni yin mod kyang*/ de dag gi bag la nyal dang gnas ngan len spangs pa ma yin zhing*/

shes bya'i sgrib pa yang ma spangs pas na/ spangs pa mtha' dag ma rdzogs pa dang*/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos kyi gnas tshul ma lus pa mngon sum du ma rtogs pas/ rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag ma rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can rnams la tshad med pa'i snying rje tsam 'jug pa yod kyang*/ de dag bdag nyid kyis 'khor ba las sgrol bar brtson pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa med pa dang*/ sems can nye tshe ba tsam ma gtogs/ phyogs dus tshad med pa'i sems can 'khor ba las sgrol bar nus pa ma yin no/ / gzhan yang nyan thos kyi theg pa'i sde snod gsum gyis kyang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par ma bstan te/ de ltar yang*/ rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*/ /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad de/ /byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las kyang*/ bsam pa dang ni bstan pa dang*/ / sbyor ba dang ni ston pa dang*/ /dus 'gal phyir na dman pa gang*/ /de ni dman pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang rgyal rnams la yang*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med la gsal snang skyes pa la sogs pa'i lam gyi mngon rtogs kyi khyad par cung zad tsam ma gtogs/ lhag ma gzhan rnams nyan thos dang 'dra la/ rang rgyal gyi lam ston pa'i sde snod la sogs pa zhig yod pa dang*/ med pa sna tshogs su gsungs pa la/ med pa ni rang re'i ston pa 'di nyid kyi bstan pa'i dbang du byas la/ yod pa ni bstan pa spyi'i dbang du byas so/ / gnyis pa/ pha rol du phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu bshad pa la/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dngos ni theg pa chen po 'di nyid de/ slob dpon dpa' bos bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i ming yang med/ /bcom ldan nyag gcig pha rol phyin/ /drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa la/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'on kyang theg pa dman pa rnams kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i phyogs mthun nam/

yan lag nye tshe ba tsam yin par ni shes so/ / 'di la gsum ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sdai snod bshad pa dang*/ de theg dman las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rgyal ba'i bka' la gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis su yod de de la yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa snying po'i mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyan lung du bstan/ /tshigs bcad ched brjod gling gzhi dang*/ /rtog brjod de lta bu byung dang*/ skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ /rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ / zhes gsungs pa las/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mdo sde yin la/ lhag ma rnams la'ang theg pa chen po ci rigs pa ni yin mod kyi/ /phal cher thun mong yin la/ mdo sde la sogs pa gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ nyung zhinganye tshe ba tsam yin la shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la ni/ mtha' med par bshad do/ /gnyis pa theg dman las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ mdo sde rgyan las ji skad du/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrib pa gnyis dag dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ / chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces theg pa chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod kyang theg dman gyi sde snod las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ theg bsdus las/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang*/ /de yi rgyu dang de rab dbye ba dang*/ /bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang*/ /ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /bstan 'di 'di ltar gzhan la ma mthong la/ /'di dag byang chub mchog gi rgyu'i mthong bas/

/gnas bcu bstan pas khyad zhugs gang yin des/ theg pa chen po sangs rgyas bka' 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan dang*/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang*/ sa'i dngos gzhi la sogs pa nas kyang*/ theg pa mchog dman gyi khyad par dang*/ theg pa chen po bka' sgrub pa'i tshul mang du gsungs so/ / gsum pa pha rol du phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu dngos bshad pa ni/ de yang mdo sde rgyan las/ rigs dang chos la mos pa dang*/ /de bzhin sems ni bskyed pa dang*/ /sbyin la sogs pa bsgrub pa dang*/ /skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang*/ /sems can rnams yongs sm-in byed dang*/ /zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang*/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ /byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la dang po rigs ni/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang*/ brgyad stong don bsdus las/ 'di ltar rnam shes rang bzhin rigs/ /bde dang shes rab bdag nyid yin/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems de nyid dge ba'i chos la goms pa las/ byang chub la nye bar gyur pa'i yon tan rgyas par 'gyur ba ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs sogs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ dka' spyod sna tshogs sbyin pa dang sogs/ rgyud bla mar ji ltar myug sogs rim skye bas sogs/ mdo lugs lnga bcu pa sogs/ de phyir rang bzhin gnas rigs de gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin kyang*/ de sad byed kyi rkyen gyis ma sad na lam du mi 'jug pa las/ de la skabs 'dir rigs sad pa ni lam gyi 'jug sgo thog ma yin no/ /rigs kyi rnam bzhag ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yod dang mchog dang mtshan nyid dang*/ /rtags dang rigs rab dbye ba dang*/ /nyes dmigs dang ni phan yon dang*/ /dpe rnams gnyis der rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang rigs tha dad pa du ma yod pa dang*/

rigs mchog dman gyi dbye ba dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dang rigs sad pa'i rtags dang*/ rigs kyi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ rigs sad pa la bar du gcod pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ rigs sad pa'i phan yon dang*/ theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi dpe rnam pa gnyis dang*/ rig bzhi'i dbye ba la sogs pa rgyas par bshad do/ / rigs sad na mos pa'i blo skye bas/ de'i 'og tu mos pa bstan te/ de la mos pa ni/ dkar po'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad kyi rtsa ba'ang mos par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di la/ mos pa'i dbye ba/ bar chad phan yon/ mos pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ sa'i sgo nas/ bdag po'i sgo nas/ chung 'bring gi sgo nas/ yul gyi/ lam gyi dbye ba ste drug las/ dang po ni/ skye dang ma skyes zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin dang bzung dang zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ grogs blang bdag nyid dang ni nor pa dang*/ /ma nor gzhan dang mngon sum ma yin gzhan/ /sgra byung 'tshol ba dang ni lta ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'phrog dang 'dres dang mi mthun phyogs ma 'dres/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ dman dang rgya che zhes so/ /drug pa ni/ bsgribs dang ma bsgribs dang*/ brtson dang mi brtson bsags dang ma bsags dang*/ /brtan bzhugs ring du song ba'i mos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa mos pa'i bar chad ni/ yid la mi byed pa mang ba dang*/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ bsod nams che dang 'gyod pa med/ / ces sogs so/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ de ltar 'phags pa chen po'i chos ni yangs gyur la/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu mos pa che bskyed na/ /bsod nams rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad dang de 'phel dang*/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ /zhes mos pa'i le'ur rgyas par bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /mos pa la gnas pas sems bskyed par byed pas/ de'i 'og tu sems bskyed bstan te/

de'i rnam bzhag ni/ byang sa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ bslab btus sogs las rgyas par bshad pas/ mdo sde rgyan las 'byung ba ltar mdo tsam brjod na/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bsdus te sems bskyed par gdams pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ spro ba che dang rtsom pa che/ /don che ba dang 'byung ba che/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' ste/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa la sa mtshams kyi dbye ba/ rang bzhin gyi dbye ba/ che ba'i dpes dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ don dam sems bskyed gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ /gzhan gyi brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab brnyes bya/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de bzhin dam par 'dod/ /ces so/ / gsum pa che ba'i dpes dbye ba ni/ /bskyed pa sa mtshungs pa ste/ /gzhan ni bzang po'i gser dang 'dra/ /zla ba yar gyi tshes pa bzhin/ /gzhan ni me dang 'dra shes bya/ /gzhan ni gter chen bzhin shes bya/ /gzhan ni rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin/ /rgya mtsho 'dra bar shes bya gzhan/ /rdo rje dang 'dra ri rab 'dra/ /

sman gyi rgyal po 'dra ba ste/ /gzhan ni 'dza' chen 'drar shes bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba dang*/ /gzhan ni nyi ma 'drar shes bya/ /gzhan ni dri za'i dbyangs snyan bzhin/ / gzhan ni rgyal po ltar shes bya/ /de bzhin gzhan ni mdzod lta bu/ /lam po che dang 'drar shes bya/ /theg pa 'dra bar shes bya ste/ /sems bskyed bkod ma 'dra ba yin/ /kun gzhi'i sgra dang 'dra ba ste/ /klung chen rgyun dang 'dra ba'o/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed pa/ /sprin dang 'dra bar bstan pa ste/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa bsdus te sems bskyed par gdams pa ni/ de phyir der yon tan dbang phyug /sems ni dga' bas yang dag bskyed/ /ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bsam pa byang chub kyi sems brtan pas/ sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu pha rol tu phy-in pa drug bstan te/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rnam bzhag ni/ theg pa chen po mdo sde thams cad nas/ zad pa med par gsungs la/ mdo don snying por dril ba ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang*/ /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa'i yon tan dang*/ /de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin shes bya/ /zhes rnam bzhag rnam pa bzhir gsungs la/ de'i don mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgra don dang*/ go rim dang*/ yan lag dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ dngos btags kyi khyad par ste rnam pa lnga las/ dang po mdo sde rgyan las/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*/ /bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*/ / mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*/ /don dam shes pa'i phy-ir bshad do/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin zhes gsungs/ / gsum pa ni de nyid las/ /sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*/

/rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /nas shes rab mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*/ nas byed rnam gsum zhes gsungs te/ de yang sbyin pa la mtshon na/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna nyams pa dang*/ sbyin pa sbyin bya/ len pa po gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi zin pa dang*/ sbyin pa de nyid kyis sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ de la brten nas sems can rnams byang chub tu smin par byed pa ste/ khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /lhag ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bas shes so/ /bzhi pa ni sbyin pa la/ zang zing gi chos kyi mi 'jigs pa ste gsum/ tshul khrims la nyes spyod sdom pa'i dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed gsum/ bzod pa la sdug bsngal dang len gyi/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa/ chos la nges par sems pa'i gsum/ brtson 'grus la/ go cha'i/ sbyor ba'i/ sems can don byed pa'i gsum/ bsam gtan la/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i/ sems can don byed kyi gsum/ shes rab la/ kun rdzob shes pa'i/ don dam shes pa'i/ sems can gyi don shes pa'i shes rab ste gsum mo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag las/ dang po gsum bsod nams gyi tshogs dang*/ phyi ma gsum ye shes kyi tshogs su zla ba grags pas bshad de/ ji skad du/ sbyin sogs chos gsum de dag phal mo cher/ /bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag ste/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyud/ /ces gsungs zhing*/ rgyal tshab byams pas ni/ dang po gnyis bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ phyi ma ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ bar pa gsum tshogs gnyis kas bsdus par gsungs te/ /de skad du yang mdo rgyan las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/

/tshogs yin shes rab ye shes te/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka'i ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ / zhes dang*/ /gzhan yang rin chen phreng ba las/ tshul khrims sbyin pa gzhan gyi don/ /brtson 'grus bzod pa bdag nyid kyi/ /bsam gtan shes rab thar pa'i rgyu/ /snying brtse bas ni don kun 'grub/ /ces kyang gsungs so/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas gzhan gyi don spyod pa la bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dgos te/ 'di'i rgyas bshad phar phyin le'u na yod/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag las rdzas tha dad du med de/ de yang zang zing sbyin pa dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ phyin drug gi don la gzhan gzhug pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang 'jug pa ste/ rim pa bzhin du byin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don spyod pa dang*/ don mthun pa rnams yin te/ byin mtshungs de ston len 'jug dang*/ /bdag nyid rjes su 'jug byed pa/ /snyan par smra dang don spyod dang*/ /don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes sogs/ lnga pa dngos btags kyi khyad par la/ 'ga' zhig ni pha rol tu phyin pa dngos ni sangs rgyas kho na la yod pa dang*/ lam zhugs kyi sbyin sogs ni/ de'i sgrub pa yin pas btags pa ba dang*/ dbu ma la 'jug par ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi byang chub phyir dngos kyang*/ /gsum dmigs yod na de ni 'jig rten pa'i/ /dmigs pa med na de nyid sangs rgyas kyis/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin ces bstan/ /ces so so'i skye bo'i lam na'ang phar phy-in drug dngos yod par bshad yod kyi/ 'dir re zhig /mdo dang bstan bcos shas che ba'i dbang du byas na/ 'phags rgyud kyi de rnams dngos dang*/ tshogs sbyor gyi de rnams btags pa ba yin no zhes shes par bya'o/ /de lta mod kyi/ yan lag bzhi po dang mi ldan pa'i sbyin sogs ni pha rol tu phyin pa dngos dang btags pa gang du yang mi rung ngo*/ /de ltar na/

sbyor ba'i lam du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgrub pa la gnas pas/ mthong ba'i lam skye bar 'gyur bas/ de 'og tu skyon med pa la 'jug pa ste/ mthong lam gyi rnam bzhag 'byung ngo*/ /de nas sa bdun pa'i bar ni/ sems can rnams yongs su smin pa'i sa dang*/ sa brgyad pa dang*/ dgu pa gnyis ni zhing rnam par sbyong ba'i sa dang*/ sa bcu pa ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa dang*/ bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od kyi sa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ni byang chub mchog ste bdag nyid kyis rang don chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ston te/ gzugs kyi sku rnam pa gnyis kyis/ gzhan gyi don rgyun chad med par spyod pa'o/ / gsum pa de dag las gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul la/ spyir mdo sngags kyi khyad par dang*/ bye brag tu mdo las sngags lhag pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyir mdo sde dang*/ rgyud sde zhes pa dang*/ mdo rgyud ces pa 'gal ba ni ma yin te/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde thams cad kyang mdo sde yin pa dang*/ cha shas tsam ston pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sde snod gsum char du gtogs pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces kyang bya ba yin te/ de yang slob dpon shan+ti pas zab mo'i don bsdus te ston pas mdo sde'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ dpung bzang las/ gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /zhes dang*/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbangapo'i rgyal po zhes sogs rgyud mang po la mdo sde'i mtshan yod pa'ang mang du 'byung ngo*/ /slob dpon a bha yā ka ra ni gsang sngags bslab pa gsum ka ston pas sde snod gsum ka'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon ar+ya de ba ni rgyud sde rnams rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces pa sde snod bzhi pa yin no zhes dang*/ dpung bzang las/ lha dang lha min rnams la phan gdags phyir/

/gsang sngags rig sngags rnam pa sna tshogs dag /bye ba phrag gsum dang ni 'bum phrag lnga/ /rig 'dzin sde snod du ni rgyal bas gsungs/ / zhes gsungs so/ /des na mdo dang bstan bcos tsam gyi dbang du byas na mu bzhi brtsir yod pa yin te/ mdo yin la rgyud ma yin pa ni/ gcig la 'phros pa la sogs pa phal che ba de dag dang*/ rgyud yin la mdo ma yin pa ni/ mkha' lding gi sbyor ba la sogs pa dang*/ mdo yang ma yin la rgyud kyang ma yin pa ni rtog ge la sogs pa'o/ /'on kyang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i khyad par ni/ tshogs lam gyi gtso bor byed pa dang mi byed pa'i khyad par ro/ /sdom gsum rab dbyer yang mdo dang rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ cho ga'i bya ba yod med yin/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'ang don de bzhin bshad na skyon med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa yod med kyi khyad par gyis/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg par bzhag pa dang*/ sngags dang sbyor ba gtso bor ston mi ston gyi sgo nas/ mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par 'jog pa'am rung ste/ de dag ni sgra don gtso bor gyur pas so/ / gnyis pa mdo las sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ spyir mdo las sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul dang*/ bye brag tu rgyud sde rnams kyang gong ma gong ma khyad par du 'phags tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon tri pi ta ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbangapo rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /rgya bod kyi slob dpon tha dad pa'i 'dod pa sna tshogs pa zhig yin mod kyi/ /de dag kyang phal che ba gtso bo'i don la rung ba kho na yin kyang*/ rang lugs ni/ rnam pa gsum gyi khyad par du 'phags pa yin te lam myur ba dang*/ lam bde ba dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par dang gsum

mo/ /dang po lam myur bas khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ lam myur ba'i ngo bo ngos gzung ba dang*/ lam myur ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skye ba 'di'am/ skye ba bcu drug gam/ bskal ba gsum mam/ bskal ba brgyad kyis byang chub thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni cho ga'i khyad par gyi lha rnams dngos su mchod pa len par yongs su spyad pa las byung ba'i bsod nams yod pa dang*/ sngags kyi mthus chu thig pa gcig la yang gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi bsod nams 'byung ba dang*/ las dang po pas ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog pa'i zhing sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byed pa dang*/ sngags sam ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par re res kyang sems can rnams smin pa'i rgyu khyad par can 'di dag /theg pa la zhugs pa tsam la yang yod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi gzugs bden pa gnyis ka'i tshul gyis 'bras bu'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i shes rab rnams/ dang po dang tha ma'i bar du yod pas na khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ / gnyis pa lam bde bas khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ lam bde ba'i ngo bo dang*/ bde bas lam bgrod pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus dang sems la tshor ba rtsub pau med pas na bde ba nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di la skal ba drug dang ldan pa'i lus kyang grub pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang ting nge 'dzin mang po thob pa dang*/ sngags kyi mthus sangs rgyas rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang*/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba'i bsam pa thams cad bsgrubs pas na'o/ / gsum pa/ thabs la mkhas pas khyad par du 'phags pa la/ bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas dang*/ spyod yul du 'jug pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ste gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang tshul khrims mnyam pas/ lha dgyes pa dang*/ spyod yul khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyod yul thams cad du lha dang sngags kyi thabs khyad par can yod pas na/

thabs la mkhas pas khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul las bshad pa'i bslab pa gsum dang*/ spyod yul la 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas kyi khyad par de dag ni 'dir yod mod kyi/ pha rol tu phyin pa la med pa'i khyad par de dag dang ldan pas na/ thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par du gyur pa ste/ go rim bzhin du/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ bskal ba grangs med sum cu gnyis/ /'bad kyang da dung byang chub med/ / bde bas tshe 'dir 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de phyir 'dod chags chen po bstan/ /zhes dang*/ bde bas bde ba thob gyur te/ /sangs rgyas bde ba bde chen no/ /'bras bu dang mtshungs rgyu sgrub pa/ /ma tshang stong pas mya ngan 'das/ /zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ /sems can don kun legs bsgrub phyir/ /blo chen la ni thabs thams cad/ /dbye ba rnam bzhir tshul gyis mchog /'gro ba'i ston pas gsungs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde rnams kyang gong ma gong ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ de yang bya ba'i rgyud la gong du bshad pa'i khyad par 'phags chos de dag ni tshang ba yin kyang bdag bskyed kyi lha'i bsnyems pa med pa dang*/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rten 'ga' zhig lhar sgom pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor du lha spyan 'dren pa sogs lha'i snyems pa nye tshe ba tsam zhig yod pa dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud chen po'am gnyis ka'i rgyud dam/ spyod pa'i rgyud du bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa yod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed chog gi bskyed pa yod pas/ lha'i snyems pa cung zad rgyas pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa yin la/ rgyud sde de gnyis char du/ lha dang sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa tsam yod kyang*/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang*/ khyad par can gyi lha'i sdom pa sogs med la/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yan chad du ni de dag kyang yod pa dang*/ khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud du thun mtshams su snang ba thams cad lhar sgom pa sogs med kyang*/

dang por ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs nas/ de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas par bsgoms pa ste/ lha'i snyems pa khyab pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o/ / gzhan yang 'di la mngon byang lngas lhar bskyed pa yod pas/ 'bras bu lam byed mchog kyang tshang ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i theg pa 'di la nang tshan du lam gyi 'gros mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang*/ gtso bo'i don la mtshungs pa kho na yin pas/ 'di la rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la yang med pa'i bskur bya dbang bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig kyang rnal 'byor rgyud las ches lhag pa dang*/ bsrung bya'i dam tshig kyang shin tu rgyas par yod pa dang*/ bde ba'i sdom pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam byed kyang 'og ma las lhag pa dang*/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su 'khor ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pa'i lam bsgoms pas/ de sbyong ba'i gnad zab mo yod pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can dang*/ yan lag drug dang*/ rim pa lnga dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi la sogs pa/ rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa'i dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ zhu bde lhan skyes dang*/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde ba sgom pa dmigs med rdzogs rim dang*/ bde ba chen pos brgyan pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ lam gyi grogs spyod pa dang nye rgyu sogs mdor na thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pa lhag pa yin la/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ bde ba'i sdom pa tshul khrims dang*/ bag chags sbyong ba dang*/ gong ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bde ba khyab pa dang*/ spyod yul de nyid la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang rang bzhin med pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ lha'i rnam pas khyab pa dang*/ des de dag nyid mchog la sbyor bas spyod yul la 'jug pa dang*/

tshul khrims ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ zab pa'i khyad par dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi thun mong dang ma yin pa dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ zab pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ gzhan yang bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rgyus tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byed pa yin te/ de la bde ba ni snying rje'i rang bzhin/ de nyid rang bzhin med cing*/ dmigs pa med par mngon sum mam/ mngon sum gyi tshul gyis las dang po pas bskyed pas/ bde bas stong pa phul du 'gyur ba mngon sum gyis rnam pa dang*/ des kyang bsod nams phul du phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa theg mchog gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa la gnyis/ sngags rgyud kyi rab dbye bshad pa dang*/ lam gyi rim pa dngos bshad pa'o/ /dngapo la sngags rgyud kyi ngo bo bshad pa dang*/ de'i rnam grangs dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa'i rang bzhin bshad pa dang*/ de'i dbye ba bshad pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la dngos btags kyi dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la sngags ni gsang sngags rnams dang bde ba chen po'i ye shes so/ /rgyud ni de'i sbyor ba ste las dang*/ dngos grub kyi tshogs rnams te/ ji skad du/ yid ni man zhes bya bar bshad/ /tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /zhes sngags kyi don bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis mtshan rtog las skyob pa'o/ /yang na gsang sngags zhes bya ba ni man+t+ra ste/ de las ma nu na yid yin la/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rjes su 'brang ba'i yid dang bcas pa'o/ /tra ]ya ni skyob pa ste/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi thabs mkhas kyis/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i rnam rtog gi yid la skyob pas na gsang sngags so/ /

bskyed rdzogs gnyis po de bzhon par byed pas na gsang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ / de skad du yang*/ ma ni de bzhin yid yin te/ /gang gang rgyu dang rkyen las byung*/ / yul dang dbang po yin no gsungs/ /tra ni de bzhin skyob par mdzod/ /ces dang*/ ma ni ston pa mtshan ma bral/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbugs dbyung ba/ /shes rab chen po bdag gis bshad/ /tra ni de bzhin skyob par brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba/ /snying rje chen po bdag gis bshad/ /stong pa dang ni snying rje gnyis/ /gnyis su med pa gnyis kyi tshul/ /gsang sngags zhes ni de la brjod/ /zhes so/ / yang na sngags rnams rgyud kyi nang du 'du ba yin te/ de la rgyud ces bya ba ni sngags rnams dang de'i cho ga'o/ /de ston par byed pa'i bka'i tshogs la rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod dang*/ rgyud ces bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dang*/ sngags kyi sde snod dang*/ chos 'di pa rnams kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod zhes pa rnams rnam grangs dang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes pa rnams rnam grangs yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang phyug gis byas pa dang*/ drang srong gis byas pa dang*/ lha dang 'byung po dang*/ gsang ba pa dag dang*/ sngags mkhan dag gis byas pa dag yin te/ de dag ni rdo rje'i theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi sde snod ni ma yin te/ gzhan du sngags dang*/ rgyud ces bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rig sngags kyi sbyor ba gtso bor ston pa'i lam dang*/ de'i 'bras bu ni sngags kyi theg pa yin no/ /lnga pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ de dag gi lam dang gzugs med pa'i khams su skye ba gzhan la sngags kyi sbyor bas bgrod par byed pa'i lam rnams so/

/gnyis pa ni/ theg pa gsum po dag go /'jig rten pa'i theg pa ni ming tsam ste/ go 'phang mi g.yo ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de la nges par 'jug pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ yul dus nyi tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa ni dngos te/ rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /de'i yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni gtso bo ma yin no/ / drug pa 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la dngos btags kyi dbye ba bshad pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa yang rnam pa gsum ste/ 'jig rten pa nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ nges pa la 'jug pa'i 'jig rten pa dang*/ sems kyi rten 'jig rten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ so so skye bos byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las 'byung ba 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam mo/ /de la phyi ma gnyis ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sder gtogs te/ de ston par byed pa rnams kyang de'i sde snod du gtogs so/ / 'phags pa'i sems kyi rang dgar byas pa yang*/ de'i sder gtogs mod kyi/ 'on kyang sde snod ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi tshul gsum ste/ mchog dang dman pa yan lag go /de gsum gyi ngo bo ni bde ba chen po dang*/ lha'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sngags dang sbyor ba tsam dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni dngos dang*/ sngags pa'i theg pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ sdom pa dang 'brel ba yin no/ /phyi ma ni de rnams ma yin te/ gzhan du sngags zhes pa tsam mo/ /yang sngags kyi tshul bdun te/ gtan du sa'i lam dang*/ cha shas can dang*/ khyad par du gyur pa dang*/ dang por bden pa dang*/ phal cher bde chen gyi tshul dang*/ 'ga' zhig bde chen dang*/ cung zad bde chen gyi tshul la sogs pa mang du yod kyang re zhig 'dir mi brjod do/ / gnyis pa lam gyi rim pa dngos bshad pa la/ lam ston byed kyi gzhung gi tshogs nges par bya ba'i phyir du rjod byed tshig gi rgyud mdor bstan pa dang*/

nyams su blangs pa'i/ sgrub pa brjod bya don gyis rgyud rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la rjod byed tshig gi rgyud ngos bzung ba dang*/ de'i dbye ba cung zad bshad pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rnams so/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar gtso bo rgyud sde bzhi po rnams yin mod kyi/ rgyud sde thams cad bsdu na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bsdus pa'i rgyud gnyis su 'du ba yin la/ yang na rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi ma'i dang*/ bshad pa'i dang*/ cha mthun gyi dang*/ 'phros pa'i rgyud de lnga'o/ /yang mdo dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ cho ga zhib mo dang*/ gzungs te bzhi dang*/ de dag gi zlas phye ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyud de lngar dbye ba la sogs pa yod do/ / gsum pa/ sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'di la ches snga rabs pa rnams/ dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas// lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams nas/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rje snang bar byed/ /mi la skal ldan dam pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa bdun na/ rgyal po dza hi'i khang steng du sngags kyi mdo sde rnams bab par 'dod pa dang*/ yang ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo brgya dang nyi shu na/ rgyal po sa hi'i khang steng du/ sngags kyi sde snod bab par 'dod pa dang*/ yang kha cig rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i khyim du byung bar 'dod pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ ston pas dpal ldan 'bras spung gi mchod rten du sngags kyi theg pa gsungs shing*/

de yang lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba gzhan rnams kyi spyad byar gyur cing*/ re zhig 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams la mi snang ba dang*/ 'on kyang sham+bha la la sogs pa'i yul khyad par can 'ga' zhig tu dar ba yin no/ / gzhan yang rgyud sde so so nas grub pa'i slob dpon so sos spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod pa thams cad kyang mi 'thad pa med do/ /'on kyang rang lugs kyi rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis te/ spyir gsang sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar byung tshul dang*/ bye brag tu 'o skol gyi ston pas gsungs tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang gis dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ rigs lnga'i dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad pa mdzad pa rnams te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis bstan to/ / 'di la dang por rdo rje sems/ /phyi nas de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid rnam bsdus nas/ /rig ma btsun mo rnam par rol/ /chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams gnas pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i rnam rol pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par bskyed/ /bdag nyid bde ba che rang bzhin// sems can khams la rjes zhugs pas/ /thams cad bde chen byang chub thob/ / bde bas mngon par zhen rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis stong nyid bstan/ / de des grangs med mngon byang chub/ /phyis nas stong par mngon zhen rnams/ / thams cad dmyal bar lhung gyur pas/ /rgyal ba rtag pa rnam sprul te/ /dbu ma la ni rnam par gzhag /rang dang gzhan don cher bsgrubs pas/ /dpag yas mchog tu dgrol bar byas/ /kun rdzob rjes zhugs ngar 'dzin can/ /rnam rtog du mas rnam dkrugs nas/ /de dag gzhan gyi bsam pa kun/ /rdzogs byed bya ba mchog la bskul/ /rin chen nyi ma rnam sprul pas/ /de dag bla med byang chub la// mchog tu dga' bas gzhol bar 'gyur/

/gzhan las rjes su chags ldan pa/ / de'i tshe 'dod chags kyis bcings pa/ /pad+ma gar dbang rnam sprul te/ /'dod chags bde ba'i lam gyis ni/ /brjod med 'gro ba mngon byang chub/ /phyi nas bde ba chags ldan rnams/ /le los mang por nyams gyur nas/ /blo ngan 'jig rten rnam par 'khrugs/ /rta mchog rgyal por rang sprul te/ /sems can brtson 'grus gnas la bzhag /byi bo rkun po dgra la sogs/ /rang rang tshul gyis mngon sprul pas/ /thams cad rdo rje'i gnas la bzhag /brtson ldan spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ /shin tu khro gtum gdug pa can/ /rab 'phros he ru kar sprul pa/ / drag shul gsod la dgyes par gyur/ /srin po gnod sbyin 'byung po gdon/ /ma mo bcom byas rig sngags dang*/ /rdzas dang mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor dang*/ /sman gyis kyang ni thams cad bcom/ /zhe sdang gdug rnon zhi ba'i phyir/ /slar yang bde chen mgon po la/ /ma 'ongs dus nas rab 'jug ste/ /dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor dam pa'o/ /'dir ni don dam kun rdzob ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa zhes/ /gzhan ni rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /'dir yang don dam rnam pa gnyis/ /bde ba che dang de nyid do/ / kun rdzob gnyis kyang 'jig rten dang*/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni re zhig bzhag /zhes gsungs zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa nas gsungs pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ / 'di la dpyad par bya ba la/ /mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /zhes sogs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gsang sngags gsungs par bshad pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa sogs las/ gsang sngags 'o skol gyi ston pas khyad chos su bshad pa mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa/ de rnams ji ltar drang zhe na/ rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du ni/

dus gsum gyi sprul pa'i sku thams cad kyis gsang sngags gsungs pa yin la/ mi'i 'jig rten du ni/ smon lam gyi khyad par mchog dang ldan pa'i 'o skol gyi ston pa sogs 'ga' zhig tsam ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa la gsang sngags 'byung ba ma yin no/ /de la kha cig sprul pa'i skus gsang sngags gsungs pa dang*/ shākya seṅges gsang sngags gsungs zhes pa'i tshig la 'khrul te/ dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad pa mdzad pa zhes pa'i rnam dbye ma chags par/ sprul pa'i sku chags bral gyi rnam pa can gyis gsang sngags gsungs par 'dod pa sogs ni/ mun sprul du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mi'i 'jig rten du ni/ sde snod kyi snga rol tu yang gsang sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa yin te/ bdud btul ba'i tshe/ gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud 'bum pa gsungs par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de yang 'o skol gyi ston pa'i sku tshe'i thog mtha' bar ma'i gnas skabs sna tshogs su gsang sngags gsungs pa yin pa las/ bya ba'i rgyud rnams ni/ gleng gzhi nas 'byung ba ltar/ lha dang mi'i gnas so sor gsungs pa dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyang*/ 'og min dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang*/ ri rab kyi rtse mo la sogs par gsungs pa gleng gzhi las shes la/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud phal cher ni lha dang mi'i 'jig rten du gsungs pa nyung ste/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i btsun mo'i bha ga chos kyi 'byung gnas sam/ chos kyi dbyings su gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i chos kyi 'byung gnas de yang*/ sangs rgyas rang snang gis bsdus pa'i zhing 'og min stug po bkod pa las gzhan du bsam par mi bya'o/ /bla med kyi rgyud 'ga' zhig ni/ u rgyan rdo rje'i gnas dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas dang*/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gsungs pa'ang yod do/

/de ltar ston pas gsang sngags kyis theg pa mtha' dag gsungs nas/ mthar gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'am/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti chen po la gtad par grags so/ / des na sngags kyi theg pa'i rgyud bsdu ba po ni/ gsangaba'i bdag po nyid yin zhing/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyis gnas na rgyud rgyas pa rnams kyang bzhugs la/ dpal de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gi rgyud mang po zhig ni lha'i gnas nas mi'i yul du byon par grags shing*/ bla med kyi rgyud phal cher ni o rgyan rdo rje'i gnas he ru ka rang byung gi gtsug lag khang nas grub pa'i slob dpon so sos spyan drangs pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgyud sde 'ga' zhig ni sham+bha la nas spyan drangs pa yang yod do/ /'o na gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'di dus nam gyi tshe na dar bar gyur snyam na/ 'di la bka' bsdu ba gsum pa mdzad pa yan chod du ni/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi tshe ba tsam las gsal bar dar ba med la/ de'i 'og tu ring por ma lon par/ lha dang klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ srin po rnams kyis gnas na/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa rnams yi ger 'dri ba sogs rtsol ba la ma ltos par/ sprul pa'i tshul gyis 'jig rten du cig car du byung ba yin no/ /bya spyod kyi rgyud rnams ni theg pa chen po dar ba dang dus mtshungs shing*/ gong du bshad pa'i lha yul nas 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gi rgyud rnams kyang dus de nyid kyi dar ba yin no/ /sher phyin 'bum pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde 'ga' zhig ni phyi nas rim gyis dar ba dang*/ thams cad kyi tha mar 'byung ba ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo yin par grags so/ / gnyis pa nyams su blangs pa'i sgrub pa'i brjod bya don gyi rgyud rgyas par bshad pa la/

rgyud sde bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang*/ de dag gi lam rim bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ /'di la snga rabs pa'i bla ma dgagrub mtha' bzhi dang*/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud bzhi dang*/ rdzogs ldan la sogs pa'i dus bzhi dang*/ mi rigs bzhi la sogs pa de rnams 'dul ba'i don du de dag dang mthun par rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa/ phal cher mi 'thad pa med mod kyang*/ de dang de kho nas dbye bar nus pa yang ma yin la/ de dag gdul bya'i gtso bor byed na ni mi rung zhing/ khyad par spyod pa'i rgyud rnams zhe sdang gi rgyud ston pa 'dul bar sbyor ba ni mi 'grig go / des na rang lugs rnam par gzhag pa ni/ mi rigs bzhi dang*/ grub mtha' bzhi la sogs pa de dag mos pa'i dgos pa ni yod mod kyis/ rgyud sde bzhi kha'i gdul bya'i gtso bo ni/ theg chen gyi lam du zhugs pa kho na yin no/ /de la 'dod khams na 'dod chags mi 'dra ba rigs bzhi yod de/ mdzod las gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang*/ /rgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag dang mtshungs par lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i khyad par gyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po la/ bya ba'i rgyud ni lta ba'i bde ba lam du byed pa yin te/ de yang don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo las/ bcom ldan 'das zhal khro gnyer can la gtod par bya zhing*/ zhes dang*/ g.yas phyogs na lha mo sgrol ma 'dzem bag dang bcas shing lus btud pas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya la mig gtod par bya'o/ /g.yon du pad+ma rigs mdzes ma 'dzem bag dang bcas pa gsang sngags kyi tshul dang rjes su mthun zhing*/ don yod zhags pa la mig gtod par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ rdo rje gtsug tor las/ dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad ni/ /dkar po'i ras la rtag gnas shing*/ /pho'ang mo la lta ba dang*/ /mo'ang pho la lta ba bri/ /zhes sogs bya rgyud kyi cho ga zhib mo thams cad nas gsungs pa yin no/

/spyod pa'i rgyud ni rgod pa'i bde ba lam du byed par rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /yid tsam 'dzum pa bzhin du bri/ /zhes dang*/ de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ / sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya ba ste/ /lha mo cung zad 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba/ /mtshungs med sku ni rab tu dwangs/ /de ni shākya thub pa'i yum/ /zhes dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang dpa' bo ni/ /pad+ma dkar po'i gdan la 'dug

/dung dang kun+da zla ba 'dra/ /dbu la 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ /de ni bag tsam 'dzum par bri/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ /sgrol ma grags pa chen mo de/ /dge zhing 'jigs pa sel ba ste/ /zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs la/ rnal 'byor rgyud lag bcang gi bde ba lam du byed par gzhan rnams na rgyas par ma gsungs kyang*/ rdo rje rtse mor gsal bar gsungs te/ de nyid las/ lha mo rdo rje ca co sgrog /pus khyud rang gi lha mo de/ /de yi glo na mgo bsgyur zhing*/ /'dzum bcas kun tu lta ba ste/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag la 'jus/ /zhes pa dang*/ dpal mchog dang po las/ de yi logs la rdo rje che/ / mda' ni gsor ba la brtson pa/ /mnyen pa'i phyag gis yongs 'khyud pa'i/ / tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bsgreng dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rnal 'byor bla med ni/ gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam du byed par rang gi rgyud sde rnams nas yang yang gsungs te/ de yang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo mchog /spyan la sogs pa bsgom par bya/ /dbangapo gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ sam bu ṭa las/ bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhing*/ /dga' ba'i gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /rba rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa la/ bya ba'i rgyud/ mdun du lha spyan drangs nas bzlas brjod byed pa tsam las/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa med pa rjes dpon lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa dang*/ spyod rgyud du bdag mdun grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud du/ phyi rol gyi lha dmigs pa'i rten tsam du bzhag la/ gtso bor nang gi lha'i rnal 'byor la spyod pa dang*/ de gsum char gyi lha'i rnal 'byor la bskyed rim gyi tha snyad don mthun du mi 'jug pa dang*/ sbyang gzhi'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa yang med do/

/ rnal 'byor bla na med par na de dag kyang yod pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad lhar sgom pa dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi lha gnas gzhan du gshegs gsol mi mnga' ba sogs khyad par du mas 'phags pa yin no/ /des na phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pas na bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi nang gi bya ba gnyis cha mnyam du spyod pas na/ gnyis ka'i rgyud dam/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ phyi'i bya ba snying po med par shes pas/ nang gi rnal 'byor la gtso bor spyod pas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ phyi nang mnyam pa nyid du shes te/ nang gi rnal 'byor kho na la spyod pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ dgyes rdor don bsdus kyi 'grel pa las/ de kho na nyid sgom pa'i nus pa chung ba mtshan ma can gyi spyod pa la mngon par dga' ba rnams phyi'i spyod pa de dag shas cher ston pa bya ba'i rgyud rdo rje gtsug tor gyi zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gang zhig bya ba'i khyad par la yang mos shing*/ thabs dang shes rab kyi spyod pa rgya chen po la yang sbyor ba'i nang gi bdag nyid can gyi tshul yang mi 'dor bar spro ba de dag ni bya ba dang rnal 'byor gyi cha gnyis la mthun pa gnyis ka'i rgyud/ phyag na rdo rje la dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba dang*/ zhes dang*/ de nyid snang ba las/ rgyud 'di ni sgom pa gtso bor gyur pa yin pas zhes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa'i 'grel pa las/ de la rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni sems mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /de'i mthus sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i dgos pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ dbang sbyin pa la sogs pa sna tshogs sbrel zhing*/ brgyud pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang gi tshig 'grel las/ 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa nang gi sbyor ba gtso bor gyur pa yin mod kyi/ phyi'i spyod pa rnams kyang med pa ma yin no/

/zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ e ma ho shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yin/ /rgyud kyi mchog gi mchog gyur pa/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes pa'i rgyud/ /ces dang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /ye shes zhes pa dri med pa/ / byang chub sems ni rin po che/ bla na med pa bshad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gur las kyang*/ e ma mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi bla ma ste/ / rtogs sla'ang rtogs par dka' ba dang*/ /rig na mi rig pa nyid do/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ rgyud rnams kun gyi bla ma ste/ /zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bla na med pa ste/ bya ba dang spyod pa la sogs pa'i bla mar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa/ de dag gi lam rim bshad pa la/ bya rgyud kyi lam rim dang*/ spyod rgyud kyi dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lam rim bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa/ grub pa'i spyod pa/ grub pa chen po'i spyod pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ dbang dang dam tshig gnyis las/ de la dbang ni chu'i dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ltar/ dam tshig sbyin pa'i dbang*/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ bgegs zhi ba'i dbang bkru ba byab srung gsum dang*/ nus pa bskyed pa'i dbang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa dang*/ longs spyod la sogs phun tshogs 'phel ba'i dbang shis pa brjod pa ste/ dbang gi cho ga rnam pa bzhi ste/ de ltar yang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ lha yi rigs rnams mthong ba la/ /dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma mnyam par bzhag pa yis/ /de dag shes nas ci rigs bya/ /slob dpon go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ /dang po yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /rig sngags rnams ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa legs par bshad pa yin/

/rig gsum dbang bskur cho ga yang*/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir/ /cho ga rgyas par bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la/ de'i bslab bya ni/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ gsang sngags la dad pa dang*/ theg pa chen po la dga' ba dang*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa la gus pas bskur ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la mi sdang ba dang*/ rang gi lha la dus tshigs su mchod pa dang*/ ston pa gzhan gyi gzhung mi mchod pa dang*/ glo bur du 'ongs pa la mgron mchod byed pa dang*/ byams pa mi btang ba dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa la brtson pa dang*/ bzlas brjod la brtson pa dang*/ dam tshig gzhan yang ci nus su bsrung ba dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya snod min la mi ston pa dang*/ rang gi sngags rgyud bsrung ba'o/ /'di dag rgyas pa ni gsang ba spyi rgyud nyid las shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ dpung bzang la gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams dang*/ legs grub kyi 'dul pa'i le'ur gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams yin la/ de dag ni bya rgyud spyi la 'gro ba yin la so so'i rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams la/ bya rgyud spyi la 'gro ba dang*/ dgos kyi bslab bya sna tshogs pa yod pas/ bye brag phyed par bya'o/ / gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa ni/ rigs drug so so'i bsnyen pa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rnams yin te/ de yang khyad chos bcu dang ldan pa'i bsnyen pa de kho na nyid bzhi dang ldan par bsgom pa'o/ khyad chos bcu ni/ dpung bzang las/ dngos grub phyir ni rnam pa bcur gsungs te/ /sngags pa dang ni rang sngags g.yog dang rdzas/ /brtson 'grus phyogs dang sa bzhin dus dag dang*/ / yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha dang sems stobs so/ /gzhan dag kha cig rig 'dzin grogs zhes zer/ /gzhan dag phyogs dang brtson 'grus dus rnams nyid/

/ gzhan ni rdzas dang sa bzhin lha dang sngags/ kha cig sems stobs yin zhes rnam par smra/ /ba sgrub phyir de ltar bcu dang brgyad dag lnga/ /de bzhin bzhi dang gsum dang gcig nyid ces/ /sngags rigs rang rang blo yi rnam par 'chad/ / sangs rgyas rgyud la cho ga gnyis kyis 'grub/ /sgrub po gang zhig rang gi yon tan rdzogs/ /brtson 'grus mchog dang yang dag ldan pa dang*/ /gzhan gyis rnyed pa dag la phrag dog med/ /'dod la ma chags lus kyis nyon mongs bzod/ / gug bskyed klad kor tshang ba zur phyin la/ /gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsten pa yi/ /gnas su bzlas nas yid 'ong dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs te/ sgrub pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ sngags dag cing cho ga ma nyams pa gnyis gtso bor bzung la/ gzhan rnams phal pa'i tshul du bstan no/ /de kho na nyid bzhi ni/ bdag nyid dang*/ lha'i dang*/ bzlas brjod kyi dang*/ bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid bzhi'o/ / dang po bdag gi de kho na nyid ni/ ji skad du/ dang po khrus byas rnal 'byor pas/ / rdo rje gdan la gnas nas ni/ /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug sgom/ / stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ sngon 'gro phyi nang gi khrus gnyis dang*/ bdag dang*/ gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang*/ dngos gzhi ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ lha drug gi rnal 'byor la sems 'dzin pa rnams so/ / gnyis pa lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ de'ang lha drug ste/ ye shes kyi lha dmigs pa'i rten du byas te/ de la stong pa nyid kyi rgyas 'debs pa ni stong pa'i lha dang*/ lha'i thugs kar sngags kyi yig 'bru la sogs pa bkod pa yi ge'i lha dang*/ bzlas brjod kyi sgra grag stong du shes pa ni/ sgra'i lha dang*/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi sku ni gzugs kyi lha dang*/

rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa'i phyag rgya byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ phyag rgya'i lha dang*/ rdul tshon la sogs pa lha mtshon byed du bzhag pa'i rten ni/ mtshan ma'i lha ste/ de ltar na drug go /gsum pa bzlas brjod kyi de kho na nyid ni/ so so'i rgyud sde nas gsungs pa bzhin du bgrang phreng gi khyad par ni/ legs grub las/ rgyal ba'i rigs la bo te tse/ /sngags kyi nor bu rab tu bsgrags/ /pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i snying*/ /rdo rje'i rigs la ru rag sha /zhes dang*/ gzhan yang dmigs pa'i khyad par dang*/ bzlas pa'i man ngag dang ldan pas sngags kyi bzlas brjod byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid ni/ ji skad du/ sngags kyi rnam par shes pa sgom/ /bsdams na ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ /srog dang rtsol ba rab tu bsdam/ /zhes pa ltar/ srog rtsol bsdam pa'i sbyor bas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin bsgru?bs pa ste/ mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor/ de kho na nyid bzhi'i nang nas kyang 'di kho na gtso bo yin te/ ji skad du/ ye shes grags pas/ mtshan mar bcas pa mtshan bcas kyi/ /dngos grub dam pa rgyal ba bzhed/ /mtshan ma med la gnas pas ni/ / mtshan mar bcas pa 'grub tu rung*/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sngags dang*/ bdag dang bzlas brjod kyi de nyid gsum shes nas bsgrubs na sangs rgyas thob ste/ de nyid las/ sgra dang sems dang de nyid gzhol/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas/ yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags bzlas/ /ngal na bdag la ngal gso zhig /mi 'gyur ba ni yi ger ldan/ /gzhi las gzhi 'gyur de bzhin te/ / gsang sngags phyir ni gang brtag pa/ /yid kyis dag pa bsam par bya/ /slar bsdus pa yis bkug nas ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsdams pa'i yid/ /gsang sngags rig pa sngags la sbyar/ yid kyis bzlas brjod brtsam par bya/ 'di nyid kyis ni cho ga yi/ /yang na shub bur bya yang rung*/ /sngags rig dngos grub 'dod pa yis/

/bzlas brjod gzhan du mi bya'o/ /rig sngags de nyid ma lus dang*/ / bdag gi de nyid cho ga dang*/ /bzlas brjod de nyid mchog shes dang*/ /mis ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ de gsum 'bras bu dang bcas pa yang*/ de nyid las/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgra gnas rnal 'byor ster bar ldan/ /sgra mthar thar pa ster pa nyid/ /de dag de nyid gsum po yin/ /zhes so/ /bsam gtan phyi ma la gsang ba'i bzlas brjod dang*/ bsam gtan ni 'ga' zhig gi sbyong rgyud kyi nyams len du'ang yod/ gsum pa grub pa'i spyod pa ni/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams dang*/ lus dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa te/ thun mong sgrub pa'i thabs rnams so/ /bzhi pa grub pa chen po'i spyod pa ni/ thun mong gi grub pa la gnas nas byang chub la sbyor ba'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la sogs pa'i sgrub pa la rtsol ba'o/ /rgyud 'dir ni thun mong gi dngos grub grub nas/ mchog gi dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi dbye bas byang chub rnam pa gsum yin la/ 'di'i lam la brten nas/ 'phags pa'i gnas thob pa'i nyan rang de dag ni/ lta ba dang grub mtha' ni theg chen yin la/ rang rgyud la skyes pa'i lam ni theg dman yin par shes so/ /rgyud 'dir ni sku gsum gyi rnam bzhag kyang rgyas par gsungs te/ theg chen spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yang gsungs/ bya ba'i rgyud kha cig las ni/ lam lnga sa bcu'i rnam bzhag theg chen spyi dang 'dra bar bshad pa yod la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan las ni/ bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar po gyur pa dang*/ de nas shākya'i rigs su skye ba zhes pa dang*/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba dang*/ lo drug dka' ba spyad pa dang*/ byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa ste/ de yan chad ni so so skye bo dang*/

de nas bdud bcom ste/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spang bya thams cad cig car spangs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes theg dman gyi sde snod dang mthun par gsungs/ de nas zhi ba'i lam la 'god pa'i 'khor lo dang po dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung 'khor lo bar pa dang*/ ston pa nyid kyi nyams myong mngon du mdzad pa 'khor lo tha ma rnams rim can du gsungs shing*/ de nas mnyan yod du mu stegs brtul ba dang*/ grong khyer me thab tu lha las bab pa dang*/ sum su rtsa gsum du gshegs nas lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod pa dang*/ de nas gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs te/ sngags kyi theg pa gsungs par bshad do/ / lam dang 'bras bu de lta bu ston pa'i rgyud la rigs drug tu yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang*/ nor bu'i rigs/ lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs te 'jig rten pa'i rigs gsum/ de ltar na drug go / de dag la rgyas par phye na 'jig rten las 'das pa gsum po de dag re re la yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang*/ rigs kyi bdag po dang*/ rigs kyi yum dang*/ gtsug tor ba dang*/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo dang*/ rigs kyi pho nya pho mo dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdus pa'i byang sems dang*/ gnas gtsang gi lha la sogs pa'i rgyud sde brgyad dam bdun du phye ba dang*/ lhag ma rnams la 'di ci rigs par phye ba yod do/ /

de thams cad bsdu na/ rigs bzhir 'du ba yin te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang 'jig rten 'khyam pa'o/ /de ltar rigs drug kyang gsum du 'dus te/ dpung bzang gi bsdus don 'grel pa'i brjed byang las/ nor can ni pad+ma'i rigs kyis bsdus so/ /rgyas pa ni rdo rje'i rigs kyis bsdus so/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs kyang de dag gi 'gab tu 'dus par rig par bya'o/ /de dag gis ma bsdus pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs las byung ba ma yin yang byang chub sems dpa' sa gnas pa ltar bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyi rigs su skyes pa yang ma yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la brten pa zhes gdags te/ zhes bshad la/ mtshan nyid dang sngags la bltas na nor bu'i rigs dang*/ rgyas pa'i rigs gnyis ka rdo rje'i rigs su 'du ba 'dra'o/ /dpung bzang las/ kha cig nga'i rigs su gtogs pa ste/ kha cig kyang ni pad+ma'i rigs su gtogs/ kha cig nor gyis rigs su gtogs pa yin/ /gzhan yang kha cig gnas med rnam par 'khyams/ /nor spyod ces pa nor gyi rigs su gsungs/ /nga yis rdo rje'i rigs la rab tu bsten/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang pad+ma'i rigs yin te/ /rigs bzhi pa ni 'dir ni lnga rtsen yin/ /ces gsungs la/ 'jig rten pas phul ba'i gsang sngags kha cig rigs bzhi la brten pa'i gnas med pas rnam par 'khyams pa ste/ rigs la sogs pa yin par bstan no/ /'o na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyis ma bsdus sam zhe na/ de'i rigs su gtogs pa ni gtsug tor la sogs pa'i ye shes las byung ba yin la/ 'di dag rnam smin gyis bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir rigs dngos kyi ma bsdus kyang*/ dad pas sangs rgyas la rig sngags kyi cho ga phul ba yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la brten pa zhes bya ba dngos su rigs lnga char gyis ma bsdus pas yongs su 'khyams pa yin te/ yongs su 'khyams pa'i rigs zhes tshig don 'grel pa'i brjed byang las bshad do/

/dpung bzang las kyang*/ gzhan yang 'di na kha cig gnas med cing*/ /bde bar gshegs la brten cing yongs 'khyams pa/ /mdo sde 'dir ni de dag thams cad kyang*/ / 'byor ba 'dod pa'i mis ni rnam par sbyar/ /zhes 'phags pa'i rigs lnga 'jig rten pa'i rigs dang drug ka la dpung bzang nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin sbyar bar bshad do/ /rgyud sde sgo drug gam/ gsum po yang*/ bsdu na gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags gnyis su 'du la/ gsang sngags ni thabs lha pho gtso che ba'i rgyud/ rig sngags ni shes rab lha mo gtso che ba'i rgyud yin la/ gzungs ni de gnyis ka'i don ston pa dang*/ shes rab kyis rtogs nas mi brjed par 'dzin pa yin pas gnyis kar du 'dus pa'am/ yang na sngags gcig lha pho mo gnyis ka'i sngags su 'gyur ba ni gzungs sngags yin no/ / gnyis pa/ spyod rgyud kyi lam rim la/ bskur bya dbang dang*/ bsrung bya dam tshig dang*/ bsgom bya mngon rtogs dang*/ bgrod bya sa lam gyi rnam bzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ltar/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ bdag po dang*/ ming ste dbang gi dngos gzhi rnam pa lnga dang*/ mig thur me long chos bshad sogs dbang gi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rnams so/ / gnyis pa dam tshig la/ bzung ba'i tshul/ thob pa'i dus mtshams/ bsrung bya dam tshig rang gi ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sta gon gyi tshe dus gsum sgrib pa med pa'i dam tshig gi lus dbul ba ste/ kun rdzob tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i tshe/ zla ba rdo rje'i cho gas don dam du sems bskyed pa dang*/ mjug gi tshe/ khas blangs pa'i tshul gyis bzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems bskyed gnyis dang dbang gi dngos gzhi'i tshe'o/ / gsum pa ni/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa mi dge ba bcu spong ba dang*/ sems can don byed kyi phyogs su gtogs pa dam pa'i chos spong ba/

byang chub kyi sems spong ba ser sna byed pa/ sems can blos spong ba dang bzhi ste/ gzhan yang spyod rgyud rigs gsum so so nas gsungs pa sna tshogs pa dag yod do/ /gsum pa bsgom bya mngon rtogs kyi rim pa la/ cha spyir spyod rgyud kyi lam thams cad 'jug pa/ sbyor ba grub pa'i spyod pa gsum du 'du tshul bshad pa'i dang po dang gnyis pa gang rung la chad lhag cung zad yod dam dpyod/ cha spyir spyod rgyud kyi lam thams cad 'jug pa/ sbyor ba grub pa'i spyod pa gsum du 'du ba las/ 'jug pa la phyi 'jug dang*/ nang 'jug gnyis las/ dngapo ni/ gong du bshad pa'i dbang thob nas dam tshig la gnas par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan bcas dang*/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gyi rnam bzhag legs par thob nas mkhas par byed pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po de la lha'i gzugs kyang rnam pa gsum ste/ yi ge dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gzugs so/ /de la yi ge la yang rnam pa gnyis te/ sgra dang byang chub kyi sems so/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang rnam pa gnyis te/ gzugs dang bcas pa dang*/ gzugs dang bcas pa ma yin pa'o/ /gsang ba'i bdag po lha'i gzugs kyang rnam pa gnyis yongs su dag pa dang*/ yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /de la yongs su dag pa ni/ rtog pa'i ngo bo ste/ mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /yongs su ma dag pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i gzugs te kha dog dang dbyibs so/ /de la lha'i gzugs rnam pa gnyis kyi dgos pa rnam pa gnyis 'grub par 'gyur te/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'o/ /mtshan ma med pas ni mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa'i dngos grub kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa sbyor ba'i dpyod pa la/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med gnyis las/ dang po ni lha yi ge'i gzugs mtshan ma gsum gyi rnal 'byor la gnas nas bzlas brjod byed pa ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i bsnyen pa yan lag dang bcas pa rnams so/

/gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa nyid ky-i don nges par byas nas/ rigs pas dpyad pa'i don bsgom pa ni/ 'jug pa'i sems dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings bsgom pa ni gnas pa'i sems dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bsgom pa ni ldang ba'i sems te/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /gsum pa grub pa'i spyod pa la/ thun mong dang*/ mchog gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdzas la sogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dod gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyis rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sgrub pa la sogs pa'o/ /de dag kyang skye ba 'di nyid la 'grub pa dang*/ bar ma dor 'grub pa dang*/ skye ba brgyud nas 'grub pa dang gsum du yod do/ / gnyis pa mchog ni sku bzhi dang ye shes lnga sgrub par byed pa'i thabs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la nan tan du byed pa'o/ / bzhi pa bgrod bya lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa la 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa bon lta bu'i sems dang*/ myu gu lta bu'i sems la sogs pa rtsa ba'i sems brgyad dang*/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i sems brgya drug cu te/ mngon mtho'i lam dang*/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam ni/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i don sgom pa nges legs la 'jug pa'i lam ste/ lam de dag gis nyan thos dang thun mong gi mthong lam mngon du byed cing*/ 'di tshun chad du bskal ba chen po gcig thogs par bshad do/ /de nas nyan thos kyi zhugs 'bras brgyad dang*/ thun mong gi rtogs pa rgyud la rim gyis bskyed cing*/ 'di la yang bskal ba chen po phyed thogs shing*/ de nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mos pas spyod pa la 'jug cing*/ 'di'i mos spyod ni tshogs lam la byed cing*/

'di la yang bskal ba chen po phyed thogs so/ /de nas mos spyod sa bcu sbyor ba'i lam la 'jug ste/ ji skad du/ mos pa'i spyod pa yis ni sa/ /sems gsum rnam par bsgoms byas nas/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams dang*/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams kyi/ /mos pa'i sa ni mtshungs pa med/ /zhes pa ltar sbyaur lam sa bcu ste/ rim pa bzhin du/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgrub pa dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la rim gyis slob pa'i sa'o/ /de ltar mos spyod kyi sa bcu la bskal chen phyed dang*/ de nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mthong ma mngon du byas nas/ 'phags pa'i sa bcu bskal chen phyed kyis bgrod de/ mthar a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ zhes pa yi ge lnga'i gzungs kyi sgo la brten te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon du byed do/ /'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ni theg chen spyi dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ / de ltar ston pa'i rgyud la rigs gsum du gnas te/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo'i rigs rnams ston pa'i rgyud gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang*/ mi g.yo ba brtul phod la sogs dang*/ gnyis pa/ gsung gi rgyud ni bod du ma gyur bar grags la/ gsum pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams so/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lam rim la/ 'jug sgo dbang gi dang*/ bsrung bya dam tshig dang*/ bsgom bya mngon rtogs kyi dang*/ bgrod bya lam gyis rnam bzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang*/ /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de la gang du dbang bskur bya'i dkyil 'khor ni/ dug lnga cha mnyam du spyod pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du/

de bzhin gshegs rigs te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i don du/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gti mug can 'dul ba'i don du/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ser sna dang phrag dog can 'dul ba'i don du/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams te/ ji skad du/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /ces pa dang*/ rtse mor rdo rje can kun khro gnyer can/ /rin chen tshogs ni rab bzhed la/ /pad+ma chen po dul zhi zhing*/ /drag po zhi ba las 'dzin pa/ /zhes dang*/ kha dog ljang gu las 'dzin pa/ /zhes so/ /'di'i don yod grub pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nang du 'du ba'o/ /de dag re re la yang sku phyag rgya chen po'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsung chos kyi phyag rgya chos kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'phrin las las kyi phyag rgya las kyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang*/ de re re la yang*/ rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring po la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/ phyag rgya bzhi po'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/ phyag rgya gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor de dag tu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ ye shes thig le'i 'grel par/ de ni drug gi bye brag dbang*/ /zhes pa chu la sogs pa lnga'i steng du slob dpon gyi dbang dang drug la 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ slob dpon gyi dbang rang la drug tshang dgos te/ ye shes thig le nyid las/ bdun gnyis bye brag tu ni yod/ /ces chu nas dbang bzhi'i bar la dbang bcu bzhir bshad cing*/ phyag chen thig le las kyang*/ slob dpon dbang la bcu gcig dbye/ /zhes dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba las kyang*/ dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can no/ /gsum pa kun nas sbyor ba ste/

/bzhi'i bdag nyid don dam pa'o/ /gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ste/ / bcu gnyis pa ni gsang ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu bzhi pa ni don dam ste/ /dbang bskur re re sa re'o/ /zhes bshad pas chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ming ste thun mong gi dbang lnga dang*/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang*/ de kho na nyid gsum brjod pa gsang ba'i dbang*/ rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod bzhi ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang drug go /yang na ye shes thig le las/ chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang*/ /dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs dang*/ /lung bstan pa dang skyabs sbyin dang*/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ye shes so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la mos pa la/ /dbang brgyad phye la sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma la mos la/ /bcu gcig bdag nyid sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa'i don 'grel par/ sngags phyag rgya ye shes rnams zhar byung du byas nas brgyad du byas nas/ de'i steng du dam tshig gsum bsnan nas bcu gcig tu byed do/ /sangs rgyas thod par/ gsang ba phyi yi lnga dang ni/ /bdun pa bcu bzhir bshad pa dang*/ /gnyis ka gcig tu 'dus pa yi/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ phyi'i lnga ni rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ bdun ni sngags/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang*/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang lung bstan pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang*/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang bdun no/ /gnyis ka dang ni gsum dang bzhi pa ste/ thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bcu bzhir bshad do/ / gnyis pa bsrung bya dam tshig gi rnam bzhag la/ spyir btang gi dam tshigarigs lnga'i dam tshig bcu bzhi dang byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa bcu bzhi de/ rigs lnga so so'i dbang du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi dam tshigasems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos rjes su chags par bya ba dang*/ khro bo'i rigs la hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor gyis mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa dang*/

pad+ma'i rigs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor las ma g.yos bzhin du/ sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa dang*/ rin po che dang las kyi rigs la/ sbyin pa rnam bzhis sems can rnams tshim par byed pa sogs/ rgyas par rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs pa yin no/ / gsum pa/ bsgom bya mngon rtogs la/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum mam rnal 'byor bzhi ste/ de yang sngon byung dang mthun par dang por 'og min du 'tshang rgya tshul dang mthun par dang por sbyor ba/ bar du ri rab kyi rtser dkyil 'khor sprul bshad mdzad pa dang mthun par dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog /mthar rigs so so'i 'khor lo bsgyur bar byas ste 'phrin las mngon par 'du mdzad pa dang mthun par las rgyal mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ rang nyid rigs kyi lha dam tshig par bskyed par rnal 'byor/ de la ye shes pa gzhug pa rjes su rnal 'byor/ brtan g.yo thams cad rang rigs kyi lha'i rnal 'byor du byed pa shin tu rnal 'byor/ de gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i snang stong la rtse gcig pa rnal 'byor chen po ste rnal 'byor bzhir gsungs te/ dpal mchog 'grel par/ de la de kho na nyid rnam pa lnga bsgoms pas bdag nyid rang gi lha'i ngo bo nyid du bskyed pa bsgom pa ni rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas de dang lhan cig tu gyur par lhag par mos pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin du bdag nyid sgom pa thams cad kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /

rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang thams cad kyi rnal 'byor rnam par bsgoms pas sems rtse gcig tu gyur pa gang yin pa ni shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de dag la mtshan ma rnyed rnyed sgom pa bsnyen pa'o/ / gnyis pa bsgrub pa ni/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub ting nge 'dzin la brten nas gtso bor sgrub pa dang*/ bzlas pa la brten nas 'jig rten 'das ma 'das kyi dngos grub gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ lha'i snang ba dang*/ de nyid sgyu ma lta bu la gsal snang dang nges shes brtan po rnyed nas/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi mchod pas lha rnams mnyes/ de nas phyag rgya sgrub/ grub nas phyag rgya'i las rab 'byams la sbyar/ de nas mtshan ma khyad par can thob nas mngon shes lnga sgrub/ de grub nas dpal mchog nas bshad pa'i rig pa'i spyod pa'i bla na med pa'i spros bcas kyi spyod pa dang phyogs 'dra zhig spyad pas/ mchog grub la/ lan gcig gis ma grub na lan bdun bskyar/ des kyang ma grub na drag shul sbyor bas 'grub pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa la brten pa la/ dbugs 'gro 'ong la brten pa kun rdzob dmigs bcas kyi rdor bzlas dang srog rtsol bkag ste bdag dang lha sngags skye med la sgom pa don dam dmigs med kyi rdor bzlas te/ dbang rnon la rdor bzlas gnyis dang*/ de bzhin gshegs rigs la sgra med/ rdo rje'i rigs la 'brug gi sgra lta bu/ pad+ma'i rigs la phra zhing gsal ba/ rin po che'i rigs la shin tu gsal bar bzla ba dbang brtul la tshig gi bzlas pa ste/ rdor bzlas 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub dang*/ tshig bzlas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bgrod bya sa lam gyi rnam bzhag la/ thob byed nyer len gyi rgyu/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems pa/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po/ lha dang sngags dang dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya thams cad kyi 'char ba'i gzhi sems kyi de kho na nyid de/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /'khor ba brgyud du 'dod pa yin/ / ces rgyu rgyud do/ / thob bya 'bras bu ni/ sgrib pa kun bral gyi rnam snang sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can no/ /rgyu dais 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs rgyud ni/ thabs phyag rgya bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ shes rab sems kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa/ so sor rang gi rig pa'i ye shes so/ /de la lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ kun gzhi rnam shes kyi gnyen por sku phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ me long ye shes mngon du byed/ nyon yid kyi gnyen por thugs dam rgya bsgoms pas mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byed/ ye shes kyi gnyen por gsungs chos rgya bsgoms pas sor rtog ye shes mngon du byed/ dbang shes kyi gnyen por 'phrin las rgya bsgoms pas/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byed/ chos dbyings ye shes de thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gnas so/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chings de ltar nges nas/ lam skye tshul bshad na rtse mor/ bskal ba brgya phrag dag tu ni/ /ci ste mngon par brtson byas kyang*/ /gang zag bzhis ni 'jig rten du/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par nyid mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni ma skyes dang*/ /the tshom ldan pa nyid dang ni/ /bka' bzhin du ni mi byed pa/ /dad pa med nyid grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems bskyed ldan pa/ rgyud la yid ches pa/ dam tshig bka' bzhin sgrub pa/ lam dang lam ston la dad pa phun sum tshogs pa ste/ chos bzhi ldan gyi sgrub pa po/ bsnyen pa la brten nas/ lha'i gsal snang rab tu phyin pa na bzlas pa rtsal thon par gyur pa'i tshe tshogs lam chen po'o/ /de la stong pa'i gsal snang thob pa'i tshe sbyor lam drod kyi rtogs pa skyes/ de las mngon shes lnga thob pa rtse mo'o/ /de phan chad sa bcu pa thob kyi bar/ lam gyi ngo bo'i khyad par ma gtogs bgrod lugs mdo dang mthun/

'on kyang myur du thob par 'dod pas brtson 'grus rtsom shing bar chad med na/ dbang rnon dang*/ dbang brtul gyi bye brag gis/ tshe lo brgya pa'i mi nas mir skye ba bdun nam bcu drug gi yun tshad la sangs rgyas thob cing*/ de yang sa bcu pa thob nas bsam gtan bzhi'i rab mtha' sgrub par bshad la/ rab mtha'i snyoms 'jug 'jig rten pa mngon pa nas bshad pa dang ni mi gcig ste/ 'di ni sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rdo rje lta bu dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba gsum tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rnam pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig phyogs mtshungs pa la bsam gtan dang po nas srid rtse'i bar du ming btags te/ de la ltos pa'i bar mtha' yin la/ de yang bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcog med pa dang*/ dang po tsam khyad gnyis gnyis pa sogs gsum/ gzugs med bzhi rnams la mthar chags su lugs 'byung lugs ldog /re re bor ba'i thod rgal du lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu byas nas/ yang mi lcogs med pa nas gsum pa'i bar du song bzhi pa la che 'bring chung gsum sogs dgur phye ba'i chen po'i chen po'i rab mtha' te/ de grub pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ni don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba ste/ de'i 'og min du bzhugs/ mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las sangs rgyas rnams kyis bslangs/ mngon byang lnga'i gdams ngag phog pas/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te/ 'jig rten thams cad du 'khor ba ji srid par sprul pa'i sku'i 'phrin las 'jug pa yin la/ mdo lam nas sngags la 'jug tshul sogs kyang spyi dang 'dra ba'i rnam bzhag yod do/ / lam rim de lta bu ston pa'i rgyud lnga ni rnal 'byor rgyud de/ de la pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis te/ dang po la rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo thams cad gsang ba/ khams gsum rnam rgyal te gsum/ grags tshod ltar na cha mthun gyi rgyud ngan song sbyong rgyud do/

/gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ sher phyin tshul la brgya lnga bcu pa'am/ dpal mchog dang po yin la/ grags pa dang bstun na cha mthun rdo rje snying rje rgyan/ gsang ba rgyan bkod/ gsang ba nor thig la sogs pa yin la/ dpal mchog la bshad rgyud yod du rung mod kyang bod du ma 'gyur zhing*/ 'phags yul na yang ma grags so/ /yang dpal mchog dang po/ de nyid bsdus pa'i cha mthun gyi rgyud yin gsung ba yod na'ang*/ phan 'dogs shing phyogs mthun la dgongs na rung la/ de'i tshe/ de nyid bsdus pa yang dpal mchog gi cha mthun du 'gyur la/ gzhan du na/ rang gis kyang pha rgyud ma rgyud gyi dbye ba mdzad pa dang 'gal lo/ kha cig 'dir bshad pha rgyud rnams dang*/ dpal mchog rnal 'byor tsam gyi rgyud/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rjes su rnal 'byor/ snying rgyan gsang rgyan gnyis shin tu rnal 'byor/ nor thig rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba yin gsung na'ang*/ sgyu drwa tshigs rigs thams cad kyang gsang 'dus dang mthun pa sogs rnal 'byor rgyud ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po yod la/ yo gar 'grel mkhan mang du byung kyang rgyu mtshan du mi rung zhing*/ lhag ma rgyud de dag la tshig zin la zab khyad re snang la/ rnal 'byor bzhir 'byed pa yid ches byung na legs por yang 'gyur mod/ 'on kyang phyi ma gsum po 'di bshad rgyud rdo rje snying rgyan nas/ bla med rnams dang lhan cig bgrangs pa dang rgyud kyi rang bzhin la dpag na bla med yin la/ brda chad mang po rnal 'byor rgyud ltar bshad na'ang yo ga nas bla med la 'jug pa'i lam gyi mtshams sbyaur du bshad pa yin par sems so/ / cha 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i dpal mchog dang po sogs bzhi ga rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du rang lugs la bzhed dam dpyod/ bzhed na de dag gtso bor rnal 'byor bla med do/ /cha bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lam rim la/ lam rim dngos bshad pa/

de ston byed rgyud sde bshad pa/ rgyud sde 'chad tshul gyi man ngag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud gsum gyis gtan la dbab dgos te/ spyod pa bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad par/ rgyal ba stobs can snying po yis/ /sngon 'gro 'grel pa kun brjod de/ /don ni rnam pa gsum du 'dus/ /rgyud dang thabs dang 'bras bu'o/ / rgyu ni theg chen rigs can te/ /dge ba'i chos kyis rnam par brgyan/ /thabs ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /dbang bkur de nyid spyod dang bcas/ /'bras bu sku gsung thun mong grub/ /ces rgyud kyi don thams cad rgyu thabs 'bras bu gsum du 'dus pa de nyid rnam par bshad par bya ste/ rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ 'bras bu rgyud do/ /de skad du yang*/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang*/ /mi 'phrog pa yi rab phye ba/ /zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo*/ / dang po la sdom ni/ ngo bo gtso bo mtshan nyid dang*/ /rnam grangs ldan pa gnas skabs dang*/ /mi 'gyur bas kyang rgyu rgyud bsdus/ /rgyu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas brgyud de 'ong ba/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba gang yin pa dang*/ sems dang sems las byung ba rnams dang*/ snod dang bcud kyi rang bzhin dang*/ rtsa dang*/ khams dang*/ chos kyi dbyings gang yin pa de rnams so/ /de rnams kyi gtso bo ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ / de nyid gang zhe na/ zhing dang*/ sku dang*/ ye shes la sogs pa 'bras bu'i chos dang mthun pa'i khyad par can/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po rgyun chad pa med pa/ chos nyid kyis thob pa ste/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ sbyang gzhi dang*/ kun gzhi dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ni rnam grangs so/ /rgyu ni du/ gzhi ni du/ kun gzhi ni du/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ni du zhe na/
