rgyu ni bcu bzhi ste/ nyon mongs pa'i rgyu dang*/ las kyi rgyu dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ snod dang*/ bcud dang*/ lam gyi rgyu dang*/ stong pa dang*/ bde ba dang zung du 'jug pa'i rgyu dang*/ rags pa dang*/ phra ba dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rgyu dang*/ gzugs kyi sku gnyis dang*/ chos kyi sku'i rgyu rnams so/ /gzhi ni bco lnga ste/ snod dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ bcud dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ nyer spyod dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ rnam par 'gyur ba dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ 'khor ba'i gzhi dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gzhi dang*/ rnam grangs kyi gzhi dang*/ mthar gtugs pa'i gzhi dang*/ kun rdzob kyi gzhi dang*/ don dam pa'i gzhi dang*/ rags pa'i gzhi dang*/ phra ba'i gzhi dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i gzhi rnams so/ / dang po lnga ni las dang bya ba'i sgo nas ste/ sbyang bya'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gsum ni bcings grol gyis rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gnyis gnyis ni dngos dang btags pa dang*/ rdzas dang btags pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /tha mar gsum ni rtogs tshul gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de la rags pa'i gzhi gang zhe na/ dgu po 'di dag ste/ gang zag tu btags pas yod pa dag la brjod de/ tsan dan dang*/ ut+pal dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ rin po che lta bu dang*/ nyon mongs pas rnam par phye ba dang*/ las kyis rnam par phye ba dang*/ lus kyis rnam par phye ba dang*/ rigs kyis rnam par phye ba'o/ /dang po lnga ni mtshan nyid kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /phyi ma bzhi ni rnam grangs kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /'dir kun gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ sde snod kyi tshul las 'byung ba kho na bzhin no/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ni gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi dang po dang*/ glo bur gyi dang po sangs rgyas so/ /'di la ji ltar na skyon dang*/ yon tan dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu dag dang 'brel bar ldan zhe na/

sad pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang*/ gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs dang*/ bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba gnas te/ dga' ba bzhi'am snang ba bzhi dang lhan cig gnas pa yin no/ /rlung bzhi dang*/ thig le bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi las dri bcas dang*/ cung zad dri bral dang*/ ches dri bral lam/ 'dzag bcas kyi dbang dang*/ 'dzag med kyi dbang dang*/ shin tu 'dzag pa dang bral ba'i dbang las/ rigs bzhi dang*/ rgyud bzhi dang*/ 'gro ba bzhi dang*/ yon tan bzhi dang*/ thun tshod bzhi dang*/ bag chags bzhis rnam par rtog pa bzhi 'byung ste/ thams cad yod par rtogs pa dang*/ rdul phran tu rtogs pa dang*/ sems tsam du rtog pa dang*/ de yang mi dmigs pa ste/ grub mtha' bzhi dang*/ sde pa bzhi dang*/ skad cig ma bzhi dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ bden pa bzhi la sgro 'dogs pa'am de dag la ji bzhin du rtogs pa ste/ de bzhin du e waṃ ma ya dang*/ gnas bzhi dang*/ rigs bzhi'i phyag rgyas dri ma sbyong ba'i khyad par dang*/ sku bzhi dang*/ rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa ji ltar rgyud las rgyas par 'byung ba de ltar shes par bya'o/ / 'dir gnas skabs gang zhe na/ thar pa'i cha mthun ma bskyed pa dang*/ skyed pa dang*/ so so skye bo'i lam dang*/ slob pa'i lam dang*/ mi slob pa'i lam rnams su/ dang po'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ lam du zhugs pa dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes ming gis btags so/ /de rnams su 'gyur ba med pa ji lta bu zhe na/ snga ma las phyi ma'i tshe ngo bor mi 'gyur ba ste/ skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnams dang*/ rten 'brel rnams dang*/ rig pa dang/ bden pa mthong ba dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa la zhugs pa dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang mi 'jig cing mi 'gyur ba'o/ / gnyis pa thabs kyi rgyu gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ dbang bskur dam tshig sdom pa dang*/

/ting 'dzin rgyud kyis sbyor ba'o/ /lnga po 'di dag ni thabs kyi rgyud de/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ dam tshig rnams dang*/ sdom pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ las dang*/ dngos grub kyi sbyor ba'o/ /dbang bskur ba gang zhe na/ bum pa dang gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ slob ma'i dbang dang phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang*/ tha mal gyi dbang dang*/ mchog gi dbang dang*/ 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ lung bstan pa dang/ gzengs bstod dang*/ yon 'bul ba dang bcas pa rnams so/ /dam tshig gang zhe na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig go /bsrung ba'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang/ yan lag gi ltung ba la sogs pa bsrung ba nyid do/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba gang zhe na/ bcu bzhi po rnams te/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad par mi bya zhing*/ /sems can rnams la byams mi spangs/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ / rang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /ma smin pa la gsang mi bsgrags/ /phung po rnams la smad mi bya/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi spong*/ /gdug pa can la byams pa spangs/ /ming sogs bral ba der mi rtog

/dad ldan sems ni sun mi dbyung*/ /dam tshig spong dang bud med smod/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes brjod do/ / 'di dag mi shes mi rung bas/ /sngon gyi mkhan po'i lung las shes/ /zhes pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / yan lag gi ltung ba gang zhe na/ bskyar dam/ dgu po rnams so/ /sgrub pa'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ spyod lam dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig dang*/ mi 'bral ba'i yo byad kyi dam tshig go /rigs lnga po rnams kyi dam tshig gang yin pa de rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang dam tshig ni gsum ste/ las dang po pa dang*/ brtan pa thob pa dang*/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig rnams so/ /yang dam tshig ni gsum ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /yang gsum ste/ bum dbang gi dam tshig dang*/ gsang dbang gi dam tshig dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i dam tshig dang*/ 'jig rten pa so so'i sgrub pa'i dam tshig dang*/ las so so'i dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa'i dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'i dam tshig go /de la dam tshig dam tshig ces bya ba ni brtul zhugs so/ /sdom pa ni thob par byed pa'i cho ga dang*/ thob pa'i dus dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ gtong ba'i dus dang*/ gso ba'i cho ga ste/ drug po de dag go /sdom ni/ cho ga dus dang ngo bo dbye/ /gtong dus gso ba'i thabs rnams so/ /de la sangs rgyas kyis ma bshad pa'i cho ga las ni sdom pa med de brtul zhugs tsam mo/ /de'i phyir cho ga ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ / dus ni dbang so so'i dngos gzhi rdzogs pa na'o/ /ngo bo ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems kyi rgyun gyi khyad par nyes pa rnams bzlog par byed pa yon tan gyi rten thun brtas pa'o/ /dbye ba ni/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong gi sdom pa gang zhe na bya ba dang rnal 'byor phyi'i sdom pa'o/

/thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ slob ma dang*/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi sdom pa rnams so/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'das pa gnyis gnyis su rtogs par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyang phal cher 'dod pas bsdus so/ / gzugs dang gzugs med pas bsdus pa dag kyang yod do/ /gtong ba'i dus ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba dag byung ba dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa spong ba de'i tshe'o/ /cha shas cha shas ni rang rang gi rtsa ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa na'o/ /gso ba'i cho ga ni/ sdig pa yongs su sbyangs nas slar yang blang ba yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ 'dir ni bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de gnyis sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ sgra don dang*/ grangs dang*/ go rim nges pa ni sngon gyi mkhan po dag gis bshad pa dang gzhan du smra bar 'dod do/ /'dir re re yang*/ ngo bo dang yan lag dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang*/ dngos dang btags pa'i khyad par ro/ /bskyed pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ rnam par rtog pas gsar du sgom pa las byung ba'i lha sku'i rnam pa can srid pa gsum dang chos mthun du sgom pa'i zhu bde ting nge 'dzin no/ /yan lag gang zhe na/ /thun mtshams sam mchod pa'i bstod pa la sogs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir yan lag ces bya zhe na/ rang gi rang gi ngo bo'i srid pa dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nyer sgrub dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub chen dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po rnams so/ /gnas skabs gang zhe na/ las dang po pa dang*/ ye shes phebs pa dang*/ ye shes la dbang ba dang ye shes la ches dbang ba rnams so/

/dang po ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa yin la/ gzhan rnams ni btags pa ba'o/ /bskyed rim gyi dpyad pa'i gnas drug gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sbyang gzhi gang yin mthar thug 'bras bu gang*/ /rdzogs rim gang gi smin byed dgos pa gang*/ /ngo bo gang yin mthar phyin tshad gang yin/ / dpyad pa'i gnas drug yan lag kun la sbyar/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ sdom ni ngo bo dbye ba so so yi/ /rang bzhin dang ni dpyad pa'i gnad/ /ngo bo gang zhe na/ sems dang yid dang rlung dbu mar thim pas/ mngon du gyur pa'i bde stong ngo*/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dngos dang btags pa dang*/ mtshan ma can dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ khyab byed dang*/ khyab bya rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la thog ma gnyis ni rang bzhin gyis dbye ba'o/ /tha ma gnyis ni tha snyad kyis phye ba'o/ /bar ba gnyis ni rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /de rnams nyid kyi rang bzhin gang zhe na/ de yang zhu ba'i bde ba lhan skyes chen po dang*/ sgyu ma'i sku dang*/ rang bzhin lhan skyes dang*/ zung 'jug gi sku dang*/ rlung dbu mar thim pa'i mthar thob pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par byang ba'i snang ba gsum dang*/ dga' ba gsum dang*/ de rnams dngos su 'thob pa'i lam gang yin pa de rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos zhes bya'o/ / btags pa gang zhe na/ rtsa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rlung dang phra mo dang*/ thig le dang*/ phyag rgya'i rim pa rlung dbu mar 'jug pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ thim par byed pa'i las can rnams so/ /mtshan ma'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma dang*/ btags pa'i mtshan ma can no/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma gang zhe na/ snang ba gsum sems dang*/ sems las byung ba'i mtshan nyid can 'od gsal bar gnas yongs su ma gyur pa ste so so'i skye bo thams cad dang gzhan la yang yod do/ /btags pa'i mtshan ma gang zhe na/ sgra don can gyi rtog pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa gang yin pa ste/

don gyi 'od gsal ma thob pa'i bar dag tu ci rigs par yod do/ /mtshan ma med pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma med pa dang*/ btags pa'i mtshan ma med pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa kho na la yod do/ /phyi ma ni so so'i skye bo la yang yod do/ khyab byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ so sor sdud pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ srog rtsol dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ snang ba dang*/ snang ba mched pa dang*/ snang ba nye bar thob pa dang*/ 'od gsal ba dang*/ snang phyogs dang*/ stong phyogs dang*/ bde ba'i phyogs dang*/ phyogs dang bral ba rnams so/ /de la dang po drug ni yan lag gis rab tu phye ba dang*/ de nas brgyad ni ngo bo nyid dang*/ de nas gsum ni rnam pa dang*/ tha ma ni rang bzhin gyis rab tu phye ba'am/ yang na bzhi ka'ang rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ / ci'i phyir khyab byed ces bya zhe na/ gang rdzogs pa'i rim pa de thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ khyab bya gang zhe na/ lus rnam par dben pa dang*/ ngag dben pa dang*/ sems dben pa dang*/ bdag byin rlabs pa dang*/ 'od gsal ba dang*/ zung 'jug dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bdag byin rlabs pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nor bu 'gengs pa dang*/ dz+wa lan+dha ra dang*/ bsam mi khyab dang*/ rang byin rlabs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*/ rgyud kyi rim pa dang*/ sngags dang*/ ye shes dang*/ gsang ba'i rim pa dang*/ so sor sdud pa la sogs yang 'ga' zhig tu yod do/ / gzhan yang sngags dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ chos dang*/ rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le dang*/ me dang*/ las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ye shes dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ snying ga'i thig le dang*/ nor bu dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ mi shigs pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ de dag la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dag go / dpyad pa'i gnad rnams gang zhe na/ smras pa/ ngo bo gang yin gang la gnad du bsnun/

/ji ltar gnas bsnun de yi nyams rtags gang*/ /yon tan gang bskyed de yi rgyu mtshan gang*/ /dngos brgyud spangs bya gang spong mthar phyin tshad/ /sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang bgegs sel dang*/ /bogs 'don ci zhig gtso 'khor khyad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas bcu gcig gi sgo nas dpyad/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa kun gyi gnad shes 'gyur/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pa lus kyi rnam par bzhag pa gang zhe na/ lus chags pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ 'jig pa'i tshul lo/ /brjod pa/ ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs nyid kyi/ /rtsa ni bye ba phyed dang bzhi/ /de las stong phrag bdun bcu gnyis/ /de las brgya bcu gnyis lhag brgya/ /de bzhin brgya dang nyi shu dang*/ /sum cu gnyis dang rtsa gsum mo/ /bskyed dang sdud pa thams cad kyi/ /gnas ni snying ga yin pa'i phyir/ /grub pa rnams dang mkhas rnams kyis/ /snying ga kho na bsngags pa yin/ khams kyang so gnyis bcu drug dang*/ khu khrag 'khor lo gnas tshul dang*/ /dkar dmar 'phel grib 'pho ba'i 'gros/ /rlung yang nyi khri chig stong dang*/ /drug brgya brgyad lhag brgy dag la/ / bcu ni rnam par shes par bya/ /re re yang ni gnas dang grangs/ /rgyu tshul kha dog mgon po dang*/ /lha mo rnams kyi dbye ba dang*/ /'jug gnas 'byung dang 'pho tshul lo/ /phung khams dbang yul ye shes lnga/ /nyer lnga phra dang rags pa'i tshul// sems de'i bzhon par gyur pa ni/ /rlung yang phra rags rnam gsum mo/ /ji ltar gnad du bsnun zhe na/ /yul gyi gnad dang*/ dus dang*/ lus dang*/ rlung dang*/ dmigs pa'i gnad do/ /dmigs pa'i gnad kyang*/ gang la sems 'jog pa dang*/ rlung sdud tshul dang*/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par te/ bzhi po de dag gis yon tan mngon du byed cing*/ dri ma rnams sbyong bar byed de/ sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang zhe na/ lam ni lnga ste/ tshogs dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam dang*/ mi slob pa'i lam mo/

/ye shes phebs pa ni tshogs kyis lam chung ngu ste dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /ye shes la ches dbang ba ni yang dag spong ba ste tshogs kyi lam 'bring po'o/ /de nyid spyod pas mthar phyin cing lta stangs rnams thogs pa med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams mngon du gyur pa dang*/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa can tshogs lam chen pa'o/ / rdzogs rim dngos kyi sems dben pa thob pa zhu ba'i bde ba mthar thug pa dbang po lnga'i rang bzhin drod dang rtse mo zhes bya la/ ye shes kyi sku nam mkha' mdzod thob pa stobs lnga dang ldan pa bzod pa dang chos mchog go /'dir rtsa dang rlung dang*/ thig le thim pa'i ye shes yon tan gyi gzhir gyur pa gong ma'i lam dang mthun pa bcu gnyis so/ /de'i tshe ye shes kyi sku la sangs rgyas zhes btags so/ /de las gzhan pa'i mos spyod kyi sa bcu yang yod do/ /'phags pa'i sa bcu dang*/ mos spyod kyi sa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ste bcu gnyis ni/ lam 'di'i sa'o cog pa bcu gnyis su sdud pa rgyud las 'byung zhing mkhan po rnams kyis kyang bshad do/ / don dam pa'i so sor rang gi rig pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ni dang por byang chub yan lag mthong ba'i lam mo/ /'di la dga' ba'i rang bzhin bden pa bcu drug dag go /slob pa'i zung 'jug rnam pa dgu ni sa lhag ma dgu'o/ /sa bcu tsam dang*/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes dag las/ rnam grol lam dang*/ khyad par lam ni sa bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum ste/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i ye shes gong ma'i gzhir gyur pa'o/ /'di dag ni sgom pa'i lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do/ /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni mthar phyin pa'o/ /man ngag las ni thog mar rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ gzhan yang sna tshogs par 'chad do/ /de dag la ni rim pa mi 'dra ba dag 'byung ste/ gal te sbyor ba'i lam du zhugs na bye brag med pa kho na'o/ /mos pas spyod pa dang*/

lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa la spyod pa/ mtshan ma la spyod pa drug dang*/ mtshan ma med pa la spyod pa bdun dang*/ mngon par 'du byed pa med par spyod pa gsum la sogs pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la spyod pa dang*/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu la sogs pa ni thams cad du mdo sde bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dir ni tshe gzhan du ma gyur pa kho na yin gyi skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'ang ma yin na/ bskal ba mang po ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de'i phyir dus myur ba kho nas rdo rje sems dpas yang dang yang du ma bstan no/ /gzhan dag ni rang rang gi man ngag nyid du rnam par bzhag gi 'dir mi brjod do/ / 'dir smras pa/ grangs nges mtshan nyid go rim nges pa dang*/ /nges tshig yon tan sbyang bya 'bras bu dang*/ /rten dang shes bya spang bya nyams len tshad/ / dbye bsdu 'di rnams rim pa kun la sbyar/ /phung khams khams gsum 'dus byas rdzas yod dang*/ /kun rdzob yod dang lus sems rten gyi khyad/ /blo rig rten 'brel zag med rab dbye bcu/ /rim pa gnyis kyi khyad par gzhan yang ni/ / btags pa dang ni mngon sum 'gyur pa'i lha/ /rags dang phra ba'i sngags dang rig 'dzin gnyis/ /las dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i khyad par dang*/ /sngags dang ye shes sku zhes rnam par phye/ /tha mal bag chags dngos su gnon dang 'joms/ /rtog pa'i srid dang snang ba'i srid 'joms dang*/ /las dang ye shes sgrib sel rnam shes dang*/ /ye shes kyis rab phyed dang dngos grub gnyis/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgyud kyi sbyor ba gang zhe na/ las kyi rgyud dang*/ dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /de la las kyi rgyud gang zhe na/ khyad par bcu'am brgyad de/ phyogs dus lha dang cha byad bsam pa dang*/ /gnas dang yul dang zas dang cho ga sngags/ /de yang bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi las dang*/ sbyin sreg gi las dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi las dang*/ sbyor ba'i las phal pa'o/

/de kho na ltar dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'on kyang dam tshig gi khyad par dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas ni lhag pa'o/ /las ni las chen bcu gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /dngos grub kyi rgyud ni gnyis ste/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub so/ /thun mong gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ rdzas kyis rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ lus dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gzugs med par 'gro ba'o/ /ngang pa dang*/ mkha' lding dang*/ khyu mchog sogs bzhon pa dang*/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo pad+ma la sogs pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi mtshon cha dang*/ yi ge dang*/ ming gi sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dang/ lha dang klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po la sogs pa bsgrubs pas gzhan la brten pa'i dngos grub mtha' yas pa yod do/ / 'di las/ che long tsam bsdus pa ni/ chung ngu ni brgyad de/ ril bu mig sman dngos grub dang*/ /sa 'og ral gri'i dngos grub dang*/ /mkha' la 'phur dang mi snang dang*/ /shi ba med dang nad 'joms so/ /'bring ni 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa phal pa'o/ /chen po ni/ tshe dang longs spyod la sogs pa bskal ba drug pa dpag tu med pa 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dngos grub gnyis kar yang spyod pas sgrub pa yin te/ thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa la zhi gnas dag lhag mthong grub pa na'o/ /

de la spyod pa gang zhe na/ gang zag dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ dus dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ cho ga'o/ /de la dbye ba gang zhe na/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros med dang*/ yang na gnyis spangs dang*/ kun bzang dang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ yang na 'dod 'jug dang*/ rten slob dang*/ rig pa brtul zhugs dang yang na re 'jog dang*/ mnyam par spyod pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag dang*/ rjes thob dang*/ chags bral dang*/ chags can dang*/ 'dod chags chen po'o/ /de yang sgom bsam dang*/ dus dang*/ bya ba dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas spyod pa gsum du bzhag go / smras pa/ gnas dang phyag rgya'i grangs dbye ba/ /mtshan nyid cha lugs khyad par ro/ /cho ga dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ spyod tshul dang*/ dbang po sbyangs ma sbyangs dang*/ gnas skabs dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sgo nas de rnams su dbye ba'o/ /'di dag ni brjod par bya ba mang ngo*/ /mchog gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /sdom ni/ khyad par ngo bo dpe rnams dang*/ /de yi rig 'dzin gyi khyad dang*/ /rig 'dzin zung 'jug yon tan dang*/ /sku dang ye shes nye rgyu'i tshul/ / gsum pa ni/ 'bras bu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ dngos dang btags pa'o/ /dngos ni rdo rje'i 'chang chen po'o/ /btags pa ni sgyu ma'i sku dang*/ zung 'jug gi sems can no/ /'di gnyis dri ma can dang*/ dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi sku ste/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'ja' lus zhes brjod kyi khams gsum pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje sku'i dpe bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ sgyu ma chu zla mig yor smig rgyu dang*/ /rmi lam brag cha mig 'phrul dri za'i grong*/ /'ja' tshon glog dang chu bur me long gzugs/ / rig pa 'dzin pa gang zhe na/ 'di ni khyad par du bdun dang ldan pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa dang*/ mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa dang*/ zhing sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang*/ 'dod cing 'chums pa med pa dang*/

'dod pa mtha' yas pa la bde ba chen por spyod pa dang*/ tshe tshad las brgal ba dang*/ yid kyi lus so/ /'dir rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ ye shes kyi sku la khyad par ci/ phung po za ma tog ma nyams pa ni ye shes kyi sku tsam mo/ /las sam ting nge 'dzin gyis nyams pa de'i tshe rig pa 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes bya'o/ / rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyang*/ yon tan brgyad tshan gnyis te/ bcu drug dang ldan pa'o/ / zung 'jug gi yon tan gang zhe na/ ro myang brgyad dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad dang*/ kha sbyor bdun dang*/ yon tan brgyad ces bya ba ste/ rtag pa dang mi gdung dang*/ /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang*/ /bde ba dang ni dri med dang*/ /dga' ba dang ni yid dang ba/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod byed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /gzugs phra reg pa yang ba dang*/ khyab dang yang dag thob pa nyid/ / rab tu gsal ba nyid brtan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ / gzhan yang byang chub kyi phyogs dang*/ tshad med dang*/ dbang bcu dang*/ stobs bcu dang*/ shes pa bcu dang*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ nyon mongs med pa dang*/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po dang*/ zad par dang*/ zil gnon dang*/ rnam thar la sogs pa'ang bshad par bya mod kyi/ de dag ni sde snod gsum gyi tshul las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /sde snod 'dir yang mtshan yang dag par brjod pa la sogs par yang bshad do/ /sku gang zhe na/ chos dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ bde ba chen po dang*/ sku bcu drug la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yongs su mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /chos kyi sku gang zhe na/

de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gang zhe na/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun mthar thug pa gcig gyur pa/ chos thams cad la rdzogs par spyod pa'o/ /de yang brda dang don no/ /brda ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /don ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kho na ste/ sems can la snang ba med do/ /sprul pa'i sku gang zhe na/ brda dang don no/ /brda ni so so skye bo 'ga' zhig la snang ba'o/ /don ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes thugs rje chen po'o/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gang zhe na/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang*/ ro myang brgyad dang ldan pa/ don dam par spros pa dang bral ba gang yin pa ste/ 'di yang chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni sku bzhi gas bsdus par rig par bya'o/ /sku bcu drug gang zhe na/ bzhi po de dag /thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku dang*/ ye shes kyis dbye bas bcu drug ste/ rlung dang*/ rdul dang*/ khu ba dang*/ rnam par shes pa dag pas 'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi gdung ba med pa dang*/ rdo rje snying rjes sems can sgrol ba dang*/ bde ba chen po zung 'jug gi rang bzhin no/ /de yang*/ yang na gnyis su med pa dang*/ g.yo ba med pa dang*/ ris med pa dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'dod chags chen po dang*/ dngos po dang dngos med zad pa dang*/ ye shes dang*/ sems pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ nyon mongs chen po dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'dzin pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang*/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /yang na mnyam pa nyid dang*/ yid kyi gzugs gnyis snang spangs pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las dang*/ bag chags spangs pa zhes pa ni sku bzhi'i don no/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa yang bshad pa/

sprul pa yis ni sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang*/ /dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang*/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa ni/ /sad rmi gnyid stug bzhi pa yi/ / dbang po gnyis skyes bde min zhing*/ /zhes 'byung ba'o/ /ye shes gang zhe na/ lnga'am bdun no/ /lnga ni me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba sgrub pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /bdun gang zhe na/ zab pa'i ye shes dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ khyab pa dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ sku dang*/ zung 'jug rnams so/ /de dag so so'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ ji skad du/ de nyid bdun 'grel las/ rang bzhin med dang rang rig pa/ /'phel ba bri ba med pa dang*/ /rnam par mi rtog snang ba po/ /bsod nams ye shes yul dang ni/ / dmigs pa 'jug pa las rnams ni/ /rgya che rab tu bshad pa yin/ /yul dang dus dang rgyud gsum dang*/ /stong dang mnyam pa nyid kyis khyab/ /rgyun mi 'chad cing 'gog pa med/ /phra rab med cing 'gyur ba med/ /bsam yas ye shes rtag pa nyid/ kha sbyor rang bzhin bde ba dang*/ /snying rje chen po gsum rang bzhin/ / yid ni rlung bcas thim pa dang*/ /zhu ba dang ni mi 'dzag bde/ /stong pa las skyes sdug bsngal 'gog /gar yang phyin dang mi g.yo ba/ /yid dang rlung gi lus can dang*/ /skad cig gcig gis kun ston dang*/ /mtshan dang dpe byad sprin spro ba/ / de ni rdo rje'i sku ru gsungs/ /gnyis min mi rtog rang bzhin zhugs/ /snang med kun nas kun tu snang*/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zung 'jug go /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nye rgyu gang zhe na/ mchog gi dngos grub la dang por dngos su reg pa dang*/ mthar thug par dngos su reg pa dang*/

gnyis kar brgyud mar reg pa'o/ /dang po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag par dbang bskur ba las 'byung ba'i spyod pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pas dbang bskur ba'o/ /gsum pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa thams cad de/ de yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byas te/ chu dang cod pan la sogs pa gsang ba'i dbang gi bar du sbyin nas/ nyi ma dmar thag chod pa ni/ shes rab ye shes sbyin te rig ma dang lhan cig tho rangs mngon par byang chub pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang*/ rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ / sgrub pa kun tu brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo*/ /'di la dang po dang tha ma la ni/ phyag rgya gsum ga yang yod do/ /bar pa la ni las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya chen po kho na yod do/ /tha ma kho na bde chen gyi lam la ni/ de dag phyag rgya chen po kho na'o/ / gnyis pa de ston byed kyi rgyud bshad pa la/ pha rgyud ma rgyud 'dod tshul la dpyad pa/ rgyud sde rigs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba 'phros dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa'i ye shes la dpyad pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ bla na med pa'i rgyud gang zhe na/ zhu ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyi bde stong gnyis su med pa ston pa gang yin pa ste/ de'i phyir 'di kho nas skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas sbyin par bya'o/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /bu ni bu mo dang*/ bu pho'i dbye gzhi ste/ 'on kyang bu ni pho kho na la brjod pa ltar rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags dang sbyor ba rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags dang*/ sbyor ba kho na rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos ni thams cad kyang dbye ba med do/

/don 'di ma rtogs par/ phyogs 'dir mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa dag kha cig ni cha chung ngus dbye bar 'dod/ kha cig ni rnam grangs du mar byed/ gzhan dag don bzang por rlom pa dag gi dbye bar 'dod de/ de yang 'di ltar dgug gzhug la sogs pa pho mos byed pa'i don zer ba/ de mtshon byed du byas pa yin gyi de kho na ma nges te/ dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug mos byed kyang*/ 'phrin las phal cher phos byed na pha rgyud du 'jog dgos pa lta bu'o/ /des na dgug gzhug bcings mnyes 'phrin las byed pa'i dpe tsam mo/ /gzhan yang thabs mi g.yo shes rab rgyu ba de yin na rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyis khyab par gsungs kyang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las des khyab par yang ma gsungs/ rgyu ba'i don/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug kho na la 'chad na/ da lta'i gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma yin pas/ gdan bzhi pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka ma yin par thal bar 'gyur te/ shes rab rgyu bas pha rgyud ma yin pa dang*/ thabs mi g.yo ba ma tshang bas ma rgyud kyang ma yin par 'gyur bas so/ /dgug gzhug la 'dod pa 'di dus 'khor ba snga rabs pa 'ga' re dang*/ phyogs mchan dang*/ bu mchan gnyis ka na yod/ 'khrul gzhi sems 'grel gzhan gyi'ang byas so/ /gzhan yang mar do'i rjes 'brang sogs dkyil 'khor gyi dbus gtso bo'i gnas na pho mo mang nyung la 'chad pa dang*/ gzhan dag pho mo gtso che chung la 'chad pa dang*/ lha grangs pho mo'i mang nyung dang*/ gzhan dngos gsung ba po yab yum gyi khyad dang*/ kha cig zhu ba po pho mo'i khyad dang*/ 'ga' zhig gleng gzhi 'di skad sogs dang gsang ba sogs kyi khyad du 'dod pa dang*/ gzhan yang cha phra ba g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang dang*/ zhi khro'i nyams so so ba dang*/ 'dres pa dang*/ rgyan dang*/ phyag mtshan na bza' la sogs pa dang*/ dur khrod yod med sogs 'dod pa dang*/ dus 'khor las dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa'i 'grel tshig 'ga' las 'khrul gzhi byung nas/

lha bzhugs bzhengs shas che chung dang*/ yab yum zhal phyag grangs mnyam mi mnyam dang*/ gzhal yas khang 'byung bzhi las bskyed pa dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bskyed pa'i khyad par du 'dod pa sogs byung ste thams cad ma nges pa sha stag yin no/ kha cig rdzogs rim phyag rgya'i lam gtso bor 'don pa ma rgyud/ rang lus kyi gtso bor 'don pa pha rgyud yin zer te/ gsang 'dus nas chags lam zhal gsal la grol lam pa'i rdzogs rim bsdus shing gab par yod pa dang*/ ma rgyud phal cher gnyis ka gsal bar cher ma nges/ gzhan rlung gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud rtsa'am thig le gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud zer yang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis ka ma yin par thal ba dang*/ gsung 'dus rdor phreng gnyis kar thal ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ sdom byung sam bu ṭi sogs kyang gnyis yin du 'gyur ro/ /sa skya pa rnams bskyed rim gtso bor 'don pa pha/ mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim gtso bor 'don pa ma rgyud phal pa/ zab mo'i rdzogs rim gtso bor 'don pa gnyis med ces gsungs/ gzhan 'ga' yang de mtshungs la gnyis med mi 'dod par rim gnyis pha ma so so sbyar ro/ /'di ni legs par brtags na/ gang na bskyed rim gyi rnam bzhag rgyas par ston pa phal cher na rdzogs rim rgyas par ston pa rang mang la/ rdzogs rim bsdus tsam las mi ston pa rnams na bskyed rim yang mi rgyas pa kho na mthong bas spyir yang mi 'thad/ pha ma gnyis kyi khyad du 'dod pa la/ brtag gnyis sam bu ṭa sdom byung gdan bzhi gsang 'dus rdor phreng sogs gnyis kar thal ba dang*/ gsang 'dus dgongs pa lung ston dang*/ lha mo bzhi zhus kyi rgyud ma rgyud du thal ba dang*/ rdo rje gur dang sangs rgyas thod pa sogs pha rgyud du thal bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs 'ga' zhig gnyis ka ma yin par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /sa lugs de ltar na yang*/

thal ba de dag phal cher 'jug cing*/ 'di'i lugs la mnyam sbyor sogs ma rgyud phal pa dang*/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor rdzogs rim mi zab pa dang*/ tsāṇ+ḍa li dang pho nya la rdzogs rim zab mo dang*/ gnyis med kyi ngos 'dzin kyai rdor la mdzad/ bde mchog gi rgyud de dag gang yin de skabs mi smra la/ 'di skabs ma rgyud khyad par can la gnyis med du btags par don gyi khas len cing*/ bde mchog gi chos skor du ma rgyud spyi dang gsang mtha' zer nas/ ma rgyud khyad par can ma rgyud dngos su yang 'chad do/ /phra thig gsang 'dus dgra nag rdo rje gur rnams las rgyas par 'chad pas/ ma rgyud phal par thal ba dang*/ zab mo'i rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pas bde mchog kyang gnyis med du thal ba dang*/ khyed kyi bzhed pa'i zab mo'i rdzogs rim gyi pho nya'i lam ni phal bar gsal zhing gsang 'dus kyang gnyis med du thal lo/ /ma rgyud khyad par can la gnyis med zer ba dang*/ ma rgyud kho nar 'chad pa'ang 'gal lo/ / yang 'di skad ces/ kyai rdor gnyis med yin pas gnyis med la shes rab kyi cha dgos pas/ mkha' 'gro ma drwa ba sdom pa sogs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin skad/ de ltar na gnyis med yin pas pha rgyud du yang ci'i phyir mi 'chad/ yang ma rgyud khyad par can phung gsum pa gnyis med yin na/ pha rgyud khyad par can yang der thal bar 'gyur/ yang ma rgyud khyad par can bde mchog yin/ kyai rdor gnyis med yin/ gnyis kas kyang zab mo'i rdzogs rim ston na/ ma rgyud khyad par can dang*/ gnyis med kyi khyad par da gdod ston dgos so/ kha cig thabs rgya che ba pha rgyud/ shes rab zab pa ma rgyud zer ba yang*/ bde dgyes las stong nyid gsang 'dus zhal gsal zhing*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i las rim sogs/ gsang 'dus las/ dgyes rdor zhal gsal ba sogs 'gal ba mang ngo*/ /gsal stong ston pa dang*/ bde stong ston pa khyad par du 'dod pa'ang yod de/

'di gnyis bla med thams cad nas rtsal du ston pa mnyam mo/ /gdul bya skyes pa 'dul ba la pha rgyud/ bud med 'dul ba ma rgyud zer rdo rje gur gyi lung 'dren no/ /lung don ni skyes pa 'dul ba gtso bo'i don la lha yab gtso bor gyur pa'i cho ga dang*/ bud med gtso bor 'dul ba la yum gtso che ba'i dkyil 'khor dang cho ga gsungs zhes pa'i don yin gyi gsang 'dus las kyang bud med 'tshang rgya tshul gsal bar gsungs la/ bde mchog gdan bzhi sogs las kyang skyed pa sgom pa'i dbang du byas pa gtso che bas de mi 'thad do/ /yang kha cig gur gyi tshig las 'khrul nas dang po nang pa kho na la zhugs pa dang*/ thog ma mu stegs la zhugs pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i don du rim pas pha ma gsung zer ba rgyu mtshan ye med cing*/ nang pa thabs dang*/ phyi pa shes rab dang rigs mthun ye med pas 'brel med kho na'o/ /sbyor sgrol sogs mu stegs dang phyogs mtshungs so snyam pa 'dug na'ang sbyor ba'i phyogs nas pha rgyud kha zin che'o/ /des na ches ma nges/ rngog pa rnams/ brjod bya thabs dang shes rab/ gdul bya skyes pa bud med kyi khyad par du 'dod pa'ang de rnams kyis bgag zin pa de'o/ /de dag ni bod snga rabs pa'i 'dod pa la rnam par brtags

pa'o/ / phyis byung la bu ston rin po ches de dag phal cher drangs/ pha ma gnyis la gzhan zer thams cad 'thad ldan du mdzad/ gnyis med phung gsum pa'i 'jog lugs re re thugs bzo mdzad nas mthar de dag re res 'jog mi thub/ thams cad tshang ba'ang dkon pas/ shas cher tshang ba la bya'o gsungs nas/ the tshom med g.yol le bzhugs so/ /bo dong pas kyang de dag thams cad bskyed nas re re zhing snga rabs pa'i lugs la dgag pa cung zad re mdzad nas/ rang lugs de dag dang 'dra min re mdzad/ gnyis med phung gsum pa'i 'jog byed re re thugs bzo ma re mdzad nas/ re res kyang 'jog thub thams cad tshang zhing gsungs te zhib tu yi ges 'jigs so/ /kyai rdor gnyis med yin te/ rgyud gzhan las rkyang ma thabs ro ma shes rab du gsungs/ 'dir de go zlog nas thabs shes phan tshun rgyas btab byas pa dang shes rab zla ba 'bab bshad pa sogs phran tshegs mang rab gsungs gur las/ kyai rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang po rgyal ba rnams kyi bshad/ /phyi ma rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med bzung phyir ro/ /zhes brtag pa dang po thabs rgyud/ gnyis pa shes rab rgyud du bshad pas gnyis med yin gsungs yang bshad rgyud sam bu ṭa kyai rdor rang gtso che gnyis med yin/ lam 'bras kyang sam bu'i ṭi'i man ngag rang gtso che/ gur dang thig le skor bzhi brtag gnyis kyi bshad rgyud yin yang ma rgyud yin gsung*/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med gsum phyi ma phyi ma mchog tu bzhed do/ /de yang ye mi 'thad de/ rgyud gzhan las rkyang ma thabs kho nar dang ro ma shes rab kho nar bshad pa'i nges pa mi snang ba dang*/ gsang 'dus rim lnga dang*/ spyod bsdus su 'byung ba ltar 'dus pa'i rgyud mang po las gsal ba/ snang ba zla ba'i chos shes rab dang*/ mchod pa nyi ma'i chos thabs su bstan pas de dag kyang gnyis med phung gsum du thal ba dang*/ brtag pa dang po chos can/

gnyis med phung gsum pa ma yin pa thal/ pha rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma chos can/ der ma yin par thal/ ma rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis gnyis med phung gsum ma yin par thal/ brtag pa gnyis pa de ni pha ma phyogs re yin pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis la brtag pa gnyis po ma yin pa'i tshigs bcad kyang med pa'i phyir/ sdom pas thabs shes gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir de'o snyam na/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud dang bde mchog gi rgyud chos can/ gnyis med kyi rgyud phung gsum pa yin par thal/ sdom pas pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ re re ba pha ma phyogs rai ma yin na ni/ lung de'i dang po pha rgyud gnyis pa ma rgyud du bshad pas zhes pa las 'brel ma byung ste/ de dag gnyis med kyi pha rgyud ma rgyud sogs su 'chad dgos pas/ yang na gnyis med yin ste gnyis med kyi pha ma yin pa'i phyir zhes grub zin sgrub pa'am/ sgrub byed bsgrub pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang na pha ma thams cad gnyis med du 'dod dgos pa las 'os mi 'byung ngo*/ /lung de 'brog 'gyur du snang la/ de la 'bru de ltar bod snga ma 'gas byas pa tshad ldan byas na de ltar khas len dgos srid na'ang*/ de'i don rdo rje gur gsung ba po kyai rdor gyis dang po rnal 'byor rgyud mang du gsungs/ phyi'i bu med de mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'khor du bsdu ba'i phyir rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud gsungs zhes pa'i don yin pas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis bla med gsung tshul la pha rgyud las ma rgyud phyi mar ston pa yin gyi/ brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i phyi ma gnyis kyi skabs kyang ma yin/ da lta'i brtag gnyis la zer ba'ang ma yin te/ de gnyis la brtag pa'i 'gros kyang med la/ 'brog 'gyur yi ge nyams pa'i 'gyur nor pas rdo rjes zhes pa sgra chad dang por zhes pa'i don ra sgra chad/ rnams la zhes pa rnams kyis zhes 'byung kyang*/ 'gos 'gyur dang de las mar pas bcos pa gnyis ka la dgyes pa'i rdo rjes rnal 'byor rgyud/

/dang por rgyal ba rnams la bshad/ /phyis nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid mo gzugs bsdu phyir ro/ /'gyur 'di legs te/ 'brog 'gyur ltar na/ dang po nyan pa po ma gsungs pas/ rjes ma la de nyid zer ba gang la snyeg ma byung*/ kyai rdor zer ba rgyud brtag gnyis la zer na brtag gnyis pha rgyud du thal bar 'gyur zhing*/ dang po kyai rdor zer ba'i pha rgyud gcig rgyal ba mang pos gsung*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud phyi ma de ni bud med bzung phyir yin zer ba las ma byung ngo*/ / des na gur las mi bskyod pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang bsres pa la dgyes rdor ces mtshan brtags pa yang yang byung ba yin mod/ dgyes rdor zer tshad brtag gnyis yin na/ a ka ru nag dgyes rdor la zer ba yang brtag gnyis la a ka ru 'bul ba lags sam/ des na dgyes rdor gyis zhes pa rdo rje 'chang gi zhes pa yin/ dang por rgyal ba rigs lnga pho gzugs 'dzin pa la gsungs/ phyi ma zer ba ma 'brel la/ phyis nas ma rgyud ni/ rgyal ba de rnams nyid mo gzugs 'dzin pa'i 'khor bsdu phyir yin/ /ces pa yin no/ /yang mar do'i 'gyur las dges rdor la sogs rgyal rnams kyis/ /sbyor ba'i rgyud ni bzhad pa las/ /de rnams bud med gzugs 'dzin pa/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud mchog la'o/ /zhes bsgyur ba ltar bshad kyang legs par 'ong ngo*/ /yang brtag gnyis chos can khyod ma rgyud yin par thal/ khyod rdo rje gur sogs kyis ma rgyud du bkral ba'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ bshad rgyud kyis rtsa rgyud kyi don log par bkral bar thal/ rtsa rgyud kyi don chog gnyis med du gnas pa de bshad rgyud kyis/ dman pa la ma rgyud tu bkral pa'i phyir ro/ / dge lugs la ni/ bla med nges pas ma khyab kyang*/ de'i 'jog byed gzhan tsho nor/ snang gsung 'od gsal/ sgyu lus kyi sku dang bcas rtsal du 'don pa pha rgyud thig le dbab zlog gi dga' bzhi rtsal du 'don pa ma rgyud zer/

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rnal 'byor rnams la rgyud du ni/ /'od gsal sgyu ma zhes bya ba/ /sgyu ma'i 'jig rten la bshad do/ /zhes pas pha rgyud kyi khyad par bstan/ ma rgyud kyi khyad par mngon sum gyis grub gsung bar gda'/ lung de'i don 'od gsal dang sgyu ma sgom pa las shes pa rnams te/ de de'i cho ga ste thabs shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas rgyud la 'jug ces pa'i don tsam zhig yin pas de'i khungs su mi rung la/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud chos can pha ma gnyis ka ma yin par thal/ tshig zin la de gnyis ka la gsal ba dang rgyas par ma bstan pa'i phyir bshad rgyud rdor phreng chos can pha ma gnyis ka yin par thal/ de gnyis ka rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ des na dgongs pa lung ston sogs dang sbyar nas sgron gsal gyis 'chad lugs la sgyu lus 'od gsal snang gsum ston pa'i tshig rnams de dang der 'chad pa'i tshe shin tu gab tshul du snang la/ 'grel pa gzhan gyis 'chad tshul gzhan du bshad pa na/ de dag gi tshig don la gsal bar zhugs pa sha stag snang ba dang*/ zhabs lugs lta bu la rjes mthun yod du chug kyang gsang 'dus kyi lugs gzhan rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par 'grel pa'ang snang bzhi dang sgyu lus kyi tha snyad ye med don yang 'phags skor lugs bzhin med pa shin tu mang ba dang*/ phug rang zhig gi don gcig pa tsam la bsam na pha rgyud ma rgyud thams cad gcig cing*/ khyed rang yang sgyu lus dang snang bzhi kyai rdor bde mchog lugs la yang 'dod pas dbye ba mi 'byung zhing 'jigs byed sogs mang po zhig la gnyis ka mi gsal bas/ gnyis min du 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad chos de gnyis pha rgyud la 'phags skor gyi gzhung kho na dang*/ ma rgyud brtag gnyis lta bu gcig gi tshig zin la 'grig rung tsam las gzhan la ma khyab khyab ches mi srid gsum tshang ba la lags so/ /shes rab rin chen pa ni las dbang dang sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud/

sher dbang dang 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud bzhi pa dang zung 'jug gtsor ston gnyis med/ gnyis med dngos dus 'khor ro/ /kyai rdor yang mi 'gal te/ bzhi pa shin tu gsal bas so zer/ yid bzang rtse ba yang*/ bzhi pa rgyud gzhan las sbas par rgyud 'grel/ bi ma la pra bha ra gsungs pa la bde gsang the/ kyai rdor mi the ye shes 'di ni sogs bzhi pa gsal bas so/ /gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma sher dbang gsal ba dang*/ rtsa rgyud las kyang gsal ba dang*/ rdo rje phreng bar dbang mtha' dag gsal ba dang*/ sam bu ṭi sogs las gsang dbang shin tu gsal ba dang*/ dus 'khor lugs kyi bzhi pa de kyai rdor las kyang bde gsang na med pa'i gsal po rang mi snang ba dang*/ ye shes 'di ni sogs dgongs pa gzhan du 'dren sla zhing 'dren pa mang ba dang*/ dbang bzhi'i ye shes ston byed sdom 'byung dang mngon brjod bla ma sogs dang sangs rgyas thod pa sogs mang por gsal po gsungs pas dbang la sbyor ba mi 'thad la/ sgyu lus pha rgyud kyi 'jog byed gong du bkag zin/ 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud du 'jog pa'ang mi 'thad de rang bzhin 'od gsal tsam la bsam na mdo sde kun yang der thal/ pha rgyud kyang thal rlung sems snying gar thim pa'i de ni ma rgyud mang po las kyang gsal po ma bshad/ pha rgyud rdor phreng la sogs pas gsal por bstan pas so/ /'o na zhu bde rtsal du ston pas de 'od gsal yin no snyam na/ de la yang 'od gsal du 'jog dgos pa'i skabs yod na'ang*/ 'od gsal chos sku lam dang*/ de bde chen spyi bo sku'i lam dang*/ gnad du bsnun pa sogs mi 'dra'o/ /zhu bde pha rgyud kyi lam gyi skabs su rgyas pas de yang mi rung ngo*/ /des na rang lugs ni rnal 'byor bla med thams cad gnyis su med pa'i rgyud yin cing*/ de la pha ma gnyis su phye ba ni dus 'khor 'grel chen na ches gsal ba yin/ rgya gar na na'ang de kho na ltar grags/

bod rnams gsum du 'byed pa ni/ rang gang la gtso bor byed pa de gnyis med du 'bad de sgrub pa'i dge ba las/ rgyud mchog gzhan rnams thabs shes ya bral du phab pa'i sdig pa che ba gcig lags/ des na pha rgyud la rigs lnga yod cing yod par snga rabs pa mang po'ang bzhed/ bu ston gyi bzhed pa la ngor phyogs pas khrel rgod byas te/ rin po che dang las rig bod du ma 'gyur bas ma mthong gsungs pa de bden te med pas so zer te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje snying rgyan las/ dam tshig mngon brgyad stong phrag gsum/ /zhes dang*/ rin chen sdong po dgu brgya bdun/ /dus kyi thig le brgya brgyad bcu/ /zhes 'byung ba la lta lung nyan lung ma byung ba'i 'chal gtam yin la/ dug gsum can 'dul ba'i dbye ba gsum du pha rgyud pa rnams byed pa ni chos legs kyang mtshan gzhir gsang 'dus rnam snang sgyu drwa gshin rje gshed gsum la byed pa mi 'thad de/ sgyu drwa chags can gyi rgyud du bshad nas zhe sdang gti mug logs su rgyud sder bshad pa'i phyir te/ snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ /zhes gsungs/ de rnams bshad zin pa na/ 'di rnams dgos pa'i bye brag gis/ /nga yis yang dag bstan par bya/ /'di ni gnyis med 'khyud pa yis/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin du ni lag bcangs dang*/ /dgod dang bltas pa'ang shes par bya/ /de bzhin zhe sdang gti mug gi /rgyud rnams kun kyang shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud kun yang*/ /'di yi rim pas shes par bya/ /phyi nang dbye ba shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dis ni ri dwags rgyal po seng ge /kha cig gsang sngags phyi nang bya ba rnying ma pa la grags khungs med gsung ba yang*/ lan re zung re tsam gyis gzhung lugs kun shes so/ /zhes thugs khengs pas rgyal nas rgyud grags chen po tsho la yang gzigs long ma byung snang bas/ rjes 'brangs phyis 'byung wa skyes long ba tsho la ni re med/

gnyis pa/ rgyud sde rigs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba 'phros dang bcas pa ni/ rgyud sde'i don spyir dug gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud yod/ 'dod chags rjes su 'dzin pa kho na la yang 'dod chags bzhi'i dbye bas rgyud sde bzhi yod/ bla med gsang 'dus dang 'brel ba chags can 'dul ba pha rgyud shes che ba tsam dngos su bgrangs/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i chags can 'dul ba'i rgyud kyang 'dis mtshon/ de bzhin du zhe sdang gti mug gi rigs la'ang rgyud sde bzhi char yod/ yab gtso bor ston pa tsho la de ltar yin par ma zad/ ma rgyud la yang dug gsum 'dul ba'i dbye ba yod/ des na dug gsum 'dul ba dang*/ pha ma'i dbye ba 'di gsang sngags phyi nang gnyis ka la yod gsungs par snang ba la/ ngor phyogs pa rnams la rgyud la dug gsum gyi rigs gsum dang ma rgyud la lnga'am/ drug kho na 'thad kyi gzhan min zer ba dang*/ drug kyang mi 'thad lnga 'thad zer ba sogs ni rgyud gzhung gi dgongs don shod mkhan ni ma byung*/ rang gis ni phal cher ma mthong*/ cung zad mthong kyang ma go /blo gros kyi mthu ni med/ bla ma'i gsung rgyun rnam dag gi lde mig med kyang gsung rab kyi bltas pas ka chog pa zhig yod par 'dug bsam nas 'ga' zhig bltas pas/ de rnams rang gi mgo ma go ba de rang gis ma shes nas dpe sgrog 'dra byas pas thugs yus/ mkhas pa tsho dang nga 'dra snyam nas blo chung tsho mgo bsdums nas bsam mod rigs dras byas pa'i chos skad du gda'o/ / des na pha brgyud la rigs kyi dbye na rigs lnga dang*/ gdul bya 'dul tshul gyis phye na rigs gsum ste/ lnga char la phyi ma gsum char yod cing*/ don la ni rgyud sde go 'phang mnyam po la lam rim mi 'dra ba med do/ /rgyud nang phan tshun kha skong dgos pas so/ /'on kyang dngos bstan la dkyil 'khor lha la kha sbyor yod med sogs lha'i rnam pa dang*/ drag po'i las gtso bor ston mi ston dang*/

stong nyid dang rten 'brel zhib mor ston mi ston/ phyag rgya'i lam dngos su gsal mi gsal sogs kyis 'byed de/ de yang rigs lnga'i dbang du byas na/ gsang 'dus dang gshed skor rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ sgyu drwa rnam snang gi rigs yin la/ rigs gsum ltar na gsang 'dus bshad rgyud dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam snang sgyu drwa dang*/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo 'bum phrag gcig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dgra nag gshed dmar le'u bcu drug pa gdong drug pa rnams chags can dang*/ 'jigs byed zhe sdang can 'dul ba yin te/ lha kha sbyor dang yab rkyang phyag rgya'i lam bshad ma bshad/ drag las gtso bor mi ston dang ston pas so/ / gshed dmar nyer gnyis pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba bla med ni ma rgyud yin par mngon la/ bde chen ral gcig dang phyag rdor gyi rgyud du grags pa 'ga' re'ang 'dug ste re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go /ma rgyud la rigs drug gi rdor sems kyi rigs ni mnyam sbyor dang*/ zla gsang thig le/ rtag pa'i rigs ni gdan bzhi/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs rdo rje bdud rtsi/ las kyi rigs 'jig rten gsum rgyal rta mchog dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs pad+ma drwa ba'am 'bar ba/ sogs te 'di gnyis bod na med/ sgrol ma 'byung ba dang*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs rta mchog gi rigs yin la/ rigs 'jigs lnga bcu pa pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs su grags/ brtag gnyis a ṛ l̥ rigs gnyis/ thig le skor bzhi sangs rgyas thod pa ma hā ma ya rnams he ru ka kho na'i rgyud yin/ gshed dmar le'u nyer gnyis pa dang*/ mi g.yo bla med kyang he ru kar gtogs/ bde mchog gtso bor he ru ka yin la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs dang lhag par 'brel/ sam bhu ṭi yang de dang 'dra/ dus 'khor rdor sems dang he ru ka'i rigs ci rigs su 'dod pa yod pa/ mi 'gal ba lta bu snang na'ang re zhig 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa yin par thams cad zhal 'chams pa dang*/

res 'ga' he ru kar rgyud las gsungs pa ltar na he ru ka gtso che bar bsdu rdo rje gur dang mngon brjod la sogs rigs lnga'am drug gi dkyil 'khor cha mnyam pa 'dra yod kyang*/ gang gi dbang du byas te he ru ka yin pas de kho nar bsdu/ mnyam sbyor dang zla gsang yang de 'dra bas rigs drug cha mnyam du mi bya rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /yang zla gsang ma rgyud 'dra ba tsam snang na'ang pha rgyud du grags pa ltar na brtag dgos la/ gal te pha rgyud yin na/ pha rgyud la yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs logs su byas te/ rigs drug tu byed dgos so/ /de ltar pha rgyud la/ rin chen sdong po rin chen rigs/ dam tshig mngon rgyan dang*/ rdo rje lnga 'dus las kyi rigs/ dus kyi thig le'i pad+ma'i rigs yin par mtshan tsam las kyang shes so/ /rgyud sde de dag bod du ma 'gyur yang*/ rdo rje snying rgyan du ming smos pa de dag sngon 'phags yul du dar nges pa dang*/ phyis kyang ci rigs pa yod do/ /gti mug can 'dul ba'i rgyud ni 'jam dpal sgyu drwa mtshan brjod yin nam snyam pa bdag ni rnam par rtog pa'o/ /

zhes gsungs/ pha rgyud ma rgyud ces bya ba bya rgyud dang spyod rgyud la don tsam gnas pa srid na yang gsal kha ma bshad/ rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis la yod/ rnal 'byor rgyudal/ sher phyin brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpal dam pa phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /yum smos pa las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yab kyang smos dgos te/ gang zhe na yab ni tran+t+ra ta tā saṃ gra ha zhes bya ba sngags kyi mdo sde zab mo yin par bshad de zhes gsung*/ gsang ba rgyan bkod yo ga yin pa ltar na/ de las rgyud kyi mtshan nyid 'chad dus/ shes rab yum du legs bshad de/ /thabs ni yab tu legs bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ thabs shes su 'jog tshul mtshan nyid mtshungs pas/ bla med kyi yang 'di go dgos so/ /bla med kyi dbye ba'i skabs 'dir/ nges pa'i lam la ltos na thams cad thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pas khyab/ gnas skabs kyi khyad chos kyis phye ba'i dbang du byas na/ thabs shes gang rung gi rgyud yin pas khyab/ de la rang lugs dkyus na gsal ba ltar mtshan nyid gsang ba rgyan bkod kyi lung gis grub/ pha rgyud ma rgyud so sor nges pa'i mtshan gzhi'i steng du khyad chos de dag tshang ba mngon sum gyis grub bo/ /rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud thams cad lam gyi cha rkyen ma tshang ba med par ston pa yin pa gang zhig sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba sogs/ yab kho na'i dbang du byas pa gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/ yum gtso che ba'am yab yum cha mnyam du ston pa gang rung yin pa ma rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/ yang na yum gyi dbang du byas pa rtsal du 'don pa zhes byas kyang chog go /de la kyai rdor bde mchog mi g.yo ba bla med sogs thams cad yab yum cha mnyam/ mnyam sbyor/ ma ya/ bdud rtsi/ ar rall̥/ sangs rgyas thod pa rnams nas/ yum gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor da lta'i rgyud chung 'di dag tu mi gsal yang*/

sngags dang las tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i gtso che bar rgyud las gsal/ gdan bzhi dang sgrol ma 'byung ba sogs/ yum kho na rtsal du 'don/ mtshan nyid kyi zur dang pos bya rgyud sogs dang*/ rgyud kyi cha shas dam dum bsgyur ba rnams dpyod do/ /dus 'khor yang sdom chen gyi yum gyi skabs dang*/ rigs brgya sogs rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor ci rigs pa ston cing*/ sngags dang las tshogs rnal 'byor ma'i dbang du byas pa rtsal du 'don te/ yang na/ mtha' dag yon tan gter ba ni bstan pa'i slad du rnal 'byor ma rnams dag la mchod par bya/ /mchod pa med na lo gcig tu ni rgyud kyi rgyal po dag ni bla mas bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la 'grel par bgegs zhi ba'i don du rnal 'byor ma la nges par mchod pa bya dgos pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi don du 'byung po la'ang gtor ma sbyin par bshad de/ 'dis rgyud 'di'i bdag mo rnal 'byor ma yin par bstan pas ma rgyud do/ /de ltar ma yin na lha yab khro bo sogs kyis bgegs zhi mi thub pa lags sam/ khro bo dang*/ klu dang*/ phyogs skyong sogs snyad 'dog chung*/ mkha' 'gro ma ko long dam pas yin lags/ da ni dus 'khor rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ma yin zer ba rnams la thog mgo bor babs pa 'dra ba gcig yod de/ nang le'i tshig tshigs bcad lnga bcu nga gcig pa/ dus kyi lo ni mi grangs lo/ /zhes pa nas/ sh+lo ka nga bdun pa'i tshig gnyis pa phyi rol gyi phyag rgya drug ces pa'i bar gyis 'grel pa mthong ba tsam gyis so/ /de yang nang le'i mdor bsdus gsum pa'i stod kyi cha la gtogs te/ da ni nyin zhag gi tshogs stong brgyad cu po de las zhes pa nas/ rigs gsum cu rtsa drug ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /zhes dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor nang gi dus 'khor sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs dang*/ sdom chen dang sdom chung gi dag pa bshad nas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi nges pa'o/

/da ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes pa nas brjod par bya'o zhes pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nges pa'o zhes gsung*/ 'di'i 'phro mthud nas slar yang mi gsal dang bcas rgyas par gsungs gda'/ pha ma gnyis su gtogs pa ma yin na/ sdom chung la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /sdom chen la rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis med bsres pa'i nges pa'o/ /dus 'khor yongs rdzogs la gnyis med kyis nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs tsang*/ kyai rdor gnyis med yin na ma rgyud ma yin zer ba la/ brtag gnyis dang gur dang phyogs mthun du 'dod pa thig le skor bzhi a rill̥ gnyis rnams nas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces yang yang gsungs pas rang gi lung dang 'gal lo/ /ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi yin yang yin la mkhas pa dang grub pa grags kyang grags pa'i dbang du mdzad nas 'grel chen dri med 'od kyis le'u lnga pa'i mdor bsdus dang por/ rang gi ngo bos ni shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor ba'i rgyud nyid de/ de skad du yang*/ kyai rdor las gsungs pa he yig rnying snying rje nas/ bshad kyis nyon zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kyai'i rdo rje ni shes rab kyi rgyud du mi 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi rgyud nyon ces gsungs pa med pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du 'dus pa la sogs pa nas/ 'di ni thabs kyi rgyud du mi 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs gsung zhing*/ de kha'i gong du kun rdzob kyi sa gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams yang dag par rgyu zhing*/ gtso bo mi g.yo ba de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /gang du thabs yang dag par brgyu zhing*/ shes rab mi g.yo ba de ni thabs kyi rgyud do zhes gsungs pa gnyis ma yin pa'i gnyis med yod na de 'di lta bu'o gsungs tsang*/ kyai rdor de 'dra'i mtshan gzhi yin cing ma rgyud ma yin na rang gi ngo bos kyai rdor ma rgyud du mi 'gyur gsungs ga la dgos te/ ma rgyud ma yin par gnyis med du grags pa la grub zin sgrub par thal bas so/

/des na tshig 'dis bla med la pha ma gnyis kyi khyab pa dang*/ gsang 'dus gnyis med pha rgyud yin pa bzhin/ kyai rdor gnyis med dang ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi yang yin pa dang*/ gsang 'dus pha rgyud kho nar grags pa bzhin/ kyai rdor ma rgyud kho nar grags pa rnams shugs bstan la gsal por byung*/ kyai rdor ma rgyud dang pha rgyud gang rung ma yin pa phung gsum gnyis med du 'dod pa 'di sham+bha la dang rgya gar la sogs su ye ma grags pa'i bod pa'i ngan rtog tu gsal bar byas so/ /gzhan yang bla med la gsum du ྄'byed pa'i khungs rgya gar nas bsgyur ba gang na yang med/ bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba/ 'gos/ gyi jo/ mar pa/ nag tsho/ dpyal chag /mar do/ lo chung*/ rwa skyo zhing gnyis sogs kyi rjes 'jug tshun chad kyi yi ge gang na'ang med la/ 'brog mi 'bro ba/ dngos slob dang bcas pa'ang mi bzhed/ sa skya rnying pa dang*/ ngor pa phal cher kyai rdor gnyis med dus 'khor ma rgyud zer/ rje btsun gong mas kyai rdor gnyis med gsung ba las gzhan mi gsal/ rong pa dang*/ shong dpang*/ bu ston rnams kyai rdor ma rgyud/ dus 'khor gnyis med ces rgyu mtshan du ma gsung*/ jo nang pa yab sras gsum dpyad pa ma mdzad par de'i rjes su 'brang*/ kun mkhyen rin po ches gsal kha ma gsungs/ phyogs pas ma rgyud du bzhed zer na'ang de 'dra'i yi ge ma mthong*/ khrid yig na gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang gda'/ rdzong pa tsho dang*/ ngor pa ci rigs kyang bo dong pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas zab pa gnyis med kyi kyai rdor/ rgya che gnyis med dus 'khor zer/ chos rje shes rab rin chen dang*/ bla ma dam pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa de dang mthun pa las zab dang rgya che ba'i tha snyad mi byed do/ /rang lugs stong pa dang snying rje/ bskyed rdzogs bde stong*/ sku dang ye shes sogs dang*/ dngos po'i gnas lugs shes rab dang*/ rtogs byed kyi thabs sogs kyi sgo nas/

bla med thams cad thabs shes cha mnyam pas/ rang gi ngo bos shes sam/ don dam par zhes pa/ thabs dang shes rab dngos sam/ don gyi thabs dang shes rab kyi cha nas gnyis med ces kyang bya/ thabs shes sbyor ba'i rgyud ces kyang bya/ shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid ces kyang bya'o/ / thabs kyi rgyud dang shes rab kyi rgyud ces mi bya/ thabs shes dngos ma yin kyang btags pa'i thabs shes so/ /don gyi thabs shes ma yin kyang*/ brda'i sgo nas mtshon pa'i thabs shes gnyis kyi dbang du byas na rgyud gnyis su 'gyur/ de yang gdul bya gzhan snang la snang ba yid kyis sgom pa'i lha yab de thabs snying rje dngos ma yin kyang*/ de'i brda yin pas der btags pa yin no/ /de'adra'i lha yum de stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dngos ma yin kyang de'i brda yin pas der btags pa yin pas so/ /mdor na thabs mi g.yo ba ni lha yab kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags sogs gtso bo'am grogs su dgos kyang des bya ba gtso bor mi byed/ 'phrin las gtso bor rnal 'byor ma'i sngags rgyud kyi byed pa'i don yin/ des gcig shos kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /de la bod snga phyi mang pos rang gang la gtso bor byed pa gnyis med du bsgrubs/ gzhan rnams phyogs re bar gnas na rang gi de gzhan las mchog tu 'grub bo snyam nas bla med la gsum du 'byed par snang ba/ sngon sngags rnying ma pa'i rdzogs chen pa bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na nges kyi rdzogs chen 'di mdo sngags ma yin de bas lhag byas pa/ ban de ye shes sdes lhag mthong ba bskyed thabs chen mor bkag /de nas snga dar phyi dar gyi mtshams las mdo sngags gang dang bstun yang ma shes/ mdo sngags gnyis ka ma yin byas na chos ma yin par song dgos nas/ rdzogs chen a ti yo ga la logs su rgyud mang po bsgrigs te/ mahā dang a nu las khyad par du gyur pa/ a ti'o zer/ mahā pha rgyud/ a nu ma rgyud/

a ti gnyis med zer/ gsar ma ba bla med pa rnams/ bde dgyes gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor gshed skor la gtso bor byed pa kho na dar/ gzhan tsho la zhar byung byed pas/ gzhan rnams gnyis med phung gsum pa yin zer mkhan ma byung*/ bde gsang mkhan pos bde gsang gnyis med phung gsum yin zer mkhan ma byung bar mngon/ kyai rdor 'brog mi lugs pa dang dus 'khor ba mang po dang*/ rgya ston sogs gshed skor ba 'ga' res de ltar 'chad mod/ mdor na phung gsum pa mi srid pas de 'dra bsgrub pa ngal ba 'ba' zhig tu zad de/ ma rgyud yin pas mi zab pa dang ngan par 'gro ba ma yin/ gnyis med yin byas pas de las zab par 'gro ba'ang ma yin te pha rgyud kyang gnyis med yin pa dang*/ gnyis med phung gsum pa ri bong rwa dang mtshungs pas so/ / des na rang gi bdag gir byas pa'i rgyud la bstod pa byas pa tsam yin kyang*/ don la ma zhugs pas phan yon med cing rdzun gyis gzhan mgo bskor ba'i nyes pa dang*/ rgyud sde gzhan smod pa'i nyes pa ma bsogs cig /des na gzhi bden gnyis sam/ shes bya gtan la 'bebs tshul dang gcig /'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i bzhugs tshul gtan la 'bebs pa dang gnyis/ thabs la lam/ mos pa/ nges 'byung gsum/ las 'bras kyi blang dor bzhi/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ skyon dang bral ba'i zhi gnas/ brtse ba snying rje chen po smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ spyod pa phar phyin sogs dang*/ lam thun mong ma yin pa/ smin byed dbang*/ bsrung bya dam tshig dngos bsgom bya rdzogs rim yongs rdzogs bskyed rim gyi ngo bo dang rim pa rnams kyis sgo nas pha ma'i dbye ba med/ thams cad gnyis med yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ bskyed rim gyi rnam pa'i khyad par dang*/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag sngags dang 'phrin las kyi khyad par las pha ma gnyis su 'byed pas de las phung gsum pa med do/ / de'i rigs 'gros las spros bcas spros med kyi spyod pa'i skabs dang khyad par cung zad 'byung ngo*/

/dngos bstan tshig zin gyi dbang du byas na/ pha rgyud las ma rgyud cung zad zab/ rgyud so so la'ang zab mi zab yod/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis shes pa'i nges pa dang*/ mthar thug gi dgongs don la mtho dman med/ slob dpon so sor byas pa'i dgongs 'grel la zab mi zab dang bzang ngan khyed shin tu che/ des na don dam par bla med thams cad gnyis med kyi rgyud yin/ kun rdzob dbye gsungs pa yang*/ blun ngor bzang bzang 'dra yang ma brtags nyams dga' tsam ste/ gsang 'dus kun rdzob tu pha rgyud don dam par gnyis med/ bde mchog kun rdzob tu ma rgyud don dam par gnyis med/ dus 'khor sogs kun rdzob don dam gnyis kar gnyis med ces gsung dgos par gda' ba la/ de ltar du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan shin tu ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa ni bzhi pa'i ye shes la dpyad par bya ste/ rgyud gang las mthar thug gi lam gyi gtso bo brjod bya'i snying po bzhi par byed pa la bsam na bla med thams cad de yin la/ de min bzhi pa dang dngos kyi mtshan nyid ston byed gsal po sho lo ka re re gnyis gnyis yod pas/ rgyud de bzhi pa tsam du 'don pas kyang ma khyab cing*/ dbang chog gi skabs dang dbang bkur ba bzhi pa zer ba'i ming 'dogs gsal po med na bzhi pa rgyas par mi ston pas kyang ma khyab bo/ /des na 'dus pa'i byang chub sems kyi le'us las kyang bzhi pa rgyas par bstan pa yin la/ bde mchog yang dbang po gang dang sogs dang*/ sngags bzlas pa dang sogs/ pho nya lhan cig skyes grub sogs dang*/ 'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin/ /sogs kyis kyang bzhi pa gsal bar bstan cing*/ de bzhin du gshin rje gshed dmar nag sogs las kyang ste bshad rgyud rnams las smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang dus kyi 'khor lo la ltos na de dag shin tu mi 'gal tshul ba la dgongs so/ /des na 'dir dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes go chod pa de dus 'khor dang sems 'grel skor gsum gyis 'chad pa yin/

rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa'ang de yin/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po grub chen gzhan rnams kyis dgongs pa'i gnad dang mi 'gal lo/ / bzhi pa cho gas bskur ba/ brda thabs yin pas gang ltar byas kyang 'dra ba zhig yod/ dngos la 'khrul ba 'phags yul du mang du byung*/ bod du yang mang*/ lam 'bras kyi rdo rje'i rba rlabs kyang dbang po gnyis skyes bzhi par 'dod pa'i lugs yin/ mngon rtogs ljon shing na dbang po gnyis skyes bzhi bar 'dod pa la dgag pa yang mang po mdzad kyang*/ rang lugs stong nyid du ngo 'phrod pa'i dbang po gnyis skyes la ka ngos 'dzin cing*/ de'i yas bab kyang bzhi pa yin pas ni 'dod la mas brtan gtso bor mdzad do/ /bo dong pa yang lam 'bras kyi mthar thug tu mdzad/ bod phyi ma ni/ dbang po gnyis skyes kyi bde stong bzhi par byed pa rgyud spyi'i dgongs pa yin la/ stong gzugs phyag chen gyis drangs pa'i zhu bde bzhi par byed pa dus 'khor gyi lugs yin/ gnyis po lugs tha dad yin pas mi 'gal zer yang*/ snga ma mi 'thad la/ lugs tha dad yin pa yang mi 'thad cing*/ 'thad na bzhi sgo gnyis su thal ba bzlog tu med la/ phyi ma yang stong gzugs yid ngor shar ba'i 'khrul snang du 'dod pa dang*/ mi 'gyur bde ba'i rten thig le bem chos sogs chos skad bsil na nor pa shin tu che/ rjes dpag gi rtsis zin pa dgos tshul sogs grub mtha'i skyon dang*/ stong gzugs dang bde chen ngo bo ngos ma zin cing sbyor tshul rnams la spyi ma shar ba du ma yod do/ /sgom chen pa gzhan mang dag dang*/ bka' brgyud pa rnams stong pa phyal yul la bzhi par ngos 'dzin pas phal cher gyis bzhi pa'i don ma rtogs la/ bzhi pa'i don la/ jo nang pa dang*/ bu ston sogs dang*/ de yan chad kyi dus 'khor ba rnams la gnad ma nor ba de yod de zhib tu zhal las shes so/ /

gsum pa rgyud sde 'chad tshul gyi man ngag bstan pa la lnga/ bsdus pa'i don 'chad tshul dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig bshad thabs/ rgyud bshad pa'i dgos pa/ 'chad dus kyi bya ba'i rim pa/ legs par bshad pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rgyud kyi gnas lnga gang zhe na sdom ni/ las rim dngos grub dam tshig sdom/ /ting 'dzin rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /las kyi rim pa ni dpag tu med de/ che long che long bsdus pa ni/ de nyid bcu phyi yi dang*/ gsang ba'i de nyid bcu'o/ /yang bcu gcig ste/ sdom ni/ sa chog sgrub dang mchod pa dang*/ /sbyin sreg dbang bskur rab gnas dang*/ /yo byad dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang*/ /tshogs 'khor bsnyen pa las tshogs so/ /yo byad ni/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ rgyan dang de dag la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bri ba dang*/ slad pa dang lus dang*/ bsam gtan no/ /sngags kyi stobs las bsod nams 'phel tshul dang*/ bde bas stong pa rtogs pa'i tshul mchog dang*/ bde dang myur dang thabs mkhas khyad par dang*/ /bslab gsum nyon mongs lam spyod 'bras bu tshul/ /dmigs pas dam tshig rgyud gzhan bskul ba yis/ /lam 'di khyad par 'phags par kun gyis bshad/ /bcu gcig po 'di gzhan la yod ma yin/ / 'di gnyis byang chub mchog la khyad par med/ /zhes pa 'di bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa la ni rgyud bdun dang*/ de'i gtam gyi sbyor ba la ni sngon byung dang rjes 'jug dang*/ rgyud 'ga' zhig la ni/ phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nang*/ /de bzhin nyid don rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes dang*/ phyi dang nang dang*/ gzhan dang*/ rton pa bzhir bshad pa dag go /shin tu sbas pa'i rgyud la ni tshul bzhi'o/ /mtha' drug ni thams cad la ste/ nges pa dang drang don la lhag ma bzhi bzhis phye bas brgyad do/ /de bzhin du gzhan la yang ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /tshul bzhir 'chad pa med pa la ni tshogs dang slob ma'i dbye ba med do/

/yi ge gsang chen du bshad pa ni yi ge'i don ma yin zhes kho bos smra'o/ / tshig gcig la don gcig gam gnyis su ston pa ni mtha' drug dang/ don rnam grangs du ma ni tshul bzhis 'chad do/ /de yang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin te/ spyi'i don du gsum mam bzhi la sogs par bshad pa yang yod de/ de dag rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa la sogs pa man ngag yod par yang 'dod do/ /gsum pa ni/ gal te tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas rgyud mnyan par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de la slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid shes pas brtags nas blangs la dbang bskur ba nod par bya'o/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas/ rim pa gnyis la zhib mor mkhas par byas la rgyud nyan no/ / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yang sgom pa dang*/ gtor ma yang sbyin pa dang*/ thams cad dkyil 'khor du bltas la slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' la yon dang*/ maṇ+ḍal byas la/ sngon byung ji lta bar sgom pa ni/ slob dpon dang slon ma gnyis kas so/ / lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ sems kyi skyon bcu gcig spangs te/ de dag gang zhe na/ nyal ba la sogs pa lus kyi gnas ngan len dang*/ rtsed mo dang*/ kyal ka dang*/ zhe sdang ba'i brgal lan dang*/ ca co dang*/ ha cang rtog ge la dga' bas gtan tshigs dang*/ thal 'gyur gyi rnam bzhag thal ba dang*/ man ngag med pa dang*/ rdzun gyi man ngag dang*/ ma smin pa'i skye bos thos pa dang*/ 'gran pa dang*/ rnyed pa'i sems so/ /gzhan yang smra ba'i rgyan dang ldan pas brjod par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni rnal 'byor la mi g.yo bas 'chad pa dang*/ mnyan pa la ni rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams lhag par yang gzigs so/ /'di'i dge ba yang*/ skye ba 'di kho na la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'gro ba la phan pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ / rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa'i snying po tsam 'di ni/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde mtha' dag gi drang nges ma nor bar 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang*/

rtsom pa dang*/ de dag gi don bsam pa dang sgom pa'i don la tshad ma'i skyes bur gyur pa rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun tā ra nā tha kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung las slob ma 'ga' zhig gis zin bris su byas pa'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel/ gcig zhus dag go /bkra shis dgra dang 'jigs pa kun las brgal/ /rnam par gzigs ni gzi brjid che/ /rdzu 'phrul ngo bo gtsug tor ro/ /thams cad skyob pa'i shes rab dang*/ /log dang sel ba'i stobs nyid dang*/ /gser sdug la ni bslab pa dang*/ /'od bsrung gi ni yon tan dang*/ /shākya thub pa'i brtson 'grus kyi/ /bdag ni rtag tu bde bar shog/// bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 96 -- PAGE 97 -- PAGE 1 -
